meta.title: Review Queue
meta.tagline: Draft cards mined from 10 years of YC batches, awaiting manual review before joining the main atlas.
about: Every card here was pulled from YC's public company directory (Winter 2016 through Fall 2026), filtered for real funding/traction by an LLM, and drafted into a card — but none of it has been read by a human yet.
This is a separate, isolated graph on purpose: nothing here should be mistaken for a vetted entry in the main atlas until it's been checked and, if it holds up, moved over.
Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, press / to search.

nodes.title: Gander
nodes.description: Gander automates global aviation operations for private jet operators. YC F24.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://usegander.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/gander

Gander builds AI‑powered software that lets private jet operators coordinate, maintain, and monetize their fleets from a single platform. The startup, with a team of seven, is based in New York City and serves the B2B aviation operations market. Gander was acquired.

_Usage:_

"How does Gander's AI coordinate maintenance across a fleet compared to traditional spreadsheets?"

"Gander's AI automatically schedules maintenance tasks, tracks parts inventory, and sends real‑time alerts, eliminating the need for manual spreadsheets."

nodes.title: Leadbay
nodes.description: Leadbay qualifies leads for agentic workflows. YC F25.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://leadbay.ai/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/leadbay

Leadbay is a B2B sales AI startup that helps teams qualify leads for agentic workflows. Teams at L'Oréal, Saint-Gobain, Gerflor USA, Corgi, and Nespresso B2B have tripled their addressable market and increased qualified leads tenfold using Leadbay. Customers report that Leadbay can produce results in ten minutes that would otherwise take six months with traditional GTM agencies or competitors like Clay.

The company operates out of San Francisco with a team of eight. Leadbay's platform is available via leadbay.ai and is part of the Fall 2025 batch.

_Usage:_

"How does Leadbay's lead qualification compare to using Clay or a traditional GTM agency?"

"Leadbay can produce qualified leads in about ten minutes, whereas Clay or a GTM agency typically take six months to achieve similar results, according to customer feedback."

nodes.title: Ticket Wallet
nodes.description: AI-optimized ticket resale platform for season ticket holders and brokers. YC Sp25.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.ticketwallet.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/ticket-wallet

Ticket Wallet is an AI-powered resale platform that automates pricing, listing, and distribution for season ticket holders and brokers across all major marketplaces. By replacing spreadsheets and manual guesswork, it streamlines the resale process and reduces the need for separate listings on each site.
Ticket Wallet has onboarded more than $3 million in ticket inventory, signed up over 100 paying sellers, and begun working with professional teams. It charges a 10 % fee per ticket sold, positioning it as a competitive alternative to other platforms that impose higher costs.

"Ticket Wallet replaces manual spreadsheets and guesswork by automatically setting optimal prices for each ticket, then listing and distributing them across all major marketplaces in a single workflow, giving sellers a more efficient and cost-effective resale experience."

nodes.title: Galen AI
nodes.description: Galen AI is a personal AI healthcare companion that aggregates medical records and wearable data to provide personalized insights and 24/7 medical support. YC Sp25.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.galenai.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/galen-ai

Galen AI aggregates medical records from over 800 healthcare institutions across more than 12,000 locations in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada, and connects with over 20 popular wearable devices such as Apple Watch, Fitbit, and Dexcom. The platform unifies all medical records and health data into a single space, enabling patients to view and manage their health information in one place.

Using state‑of‑the‑art large language model memory capabilities, Galen delivers personalized insights, proactive health recommendations, and 24/7 on‑demand medical support. The service is designed to empower patients to be active participants in their care teams, addressing the fragmentation and delays that many patients face in the current healthcare system.

Galen AI was acquired in 2025 and is currently a consumer app in beta testing, with plans to launch on the App Store soon.

_Usage:_

"How does Galen AI integrate with wearable devices compared to other health apps?"

"Galen connects to over 20 popular wearables, including Apple Watch, Fitbit, and Dexcom, pulling data directly into its unified health space. Unlike many health apps that only track fitness metrics, Galen also pulls medical records from 800+ institutions, providing a comprehensive view of a patient's health."

nodes.title: Gigacatalyst
nodes.description: AI-first embedded analytics and reports for customer success. YC Sp26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://gigacatalyst.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/gigacatalyst

Gigacatalyst lets customers build analytics, dashboards, reports, and forms directly inside their SaaS product. The platform adds an embedded AI customization layer that learns the product’s APIs, enabling users to create tailored visualizations that match their workflows and share them across teams with a single click.

By providing bespoke dashboards for each use case, Gigacatalyst helps customers use their SaaS more, retain longer, and expand sales faster. The company is already live with top Series B firms and reports a 90 % repeat usage rate.

_Usage:_

"How does Gigacatalyst's embedded AI layer differ from standard analytics tools?"

"Gigacatalyst’s AI layer learns the APIs of the host SaaS product, allowing customers to build dashboards, reports, and forms that are tightly integrated with their workflows. Unlike generic analytics tools that require exporting data, Gigacatalyst lets users create and share customized visualizations inside the product with a one‑click share feature, improving adoption and retention."

nodes.title: Arzana
nodes.description: Arzana automates manufacturers' quoting, order entry, invoicing, and other repetitive office work with custom AI models. YC Sp26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.arzana.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/arzana

Arzana trains custom models on manufacturers' operational data to automate quoting, order entry, invoicing, and other repetitive office work. It has saved customers over $1.5M in avoided staff costs.
The company plans to expand into shop‑floor automation, sending instructions to machinery and robots to produce the orders that its office agents processed. By 2035, Arzana aims to fully automate 10,000 American factories.
Based in New York City, Arzana is a small team of six focused on B2B operations. It is an active startup in the Spring 2026 batch.

_Usage:_

"How does Arzana's autonomous ERP differ from traditional ERP systems?"

"Unlike conventional ERP solutions that require manual data entry and configuration, Arzana trains custom models on a manufacturer's operational data to automatically handle quoting, order entry, invoicing, and other repetitive tasks, reducing staff costs by over $1.5M for its customers."

nodes.title: Plena Health
nodes.description: Plena is the AI operating system that automates administrative workflows for specialty medical practices. YC Sp26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.plena.health/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/plena-health

Plena is an AI operating system designed for specialty medical practices. It automates the administrative workflows that keep clinics running—referrals, fax intake, scheduling, procedure compliance, and collections—end to end across all the systems a practice already uses. Unlike point solutions that cover only a slice of the problem, Plena becomes the operating layer across the entire practice, connecting the systems, teams, and workflows that keep it running. In its first ten months, Plena grew 17 times and crossed seven figures in committed annual recurring revenue across six specialties and eight states. Eighty percent of that growth came through word of mouth, underscoring the product’s fit and the demand for a unified AI‑powered practice layer.

_Usage:_

"How does Plena integrate with a clinic’s existing EHR and practice management systems?"

"Plena connects to the systems a practice already uses, acting as an operating layer that automates referrals, fax intake, scheduling, procedure compliance, and collections across those systems. It does not replace the underlying software but instead orchestrates the data and workflows between them, providing a unified AI‑driven interface for the entire practice."

nodes.title: Userlens

nodes.title: transload
nodes.description: Transload measures freight with security cameras. YC Sp26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.transload.ai | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/transload

Transload helps logistics companies measure shipments using the security cameras they already have. A pallet, a couch, a tire – it captures the true size as it moves through the warehouse. Because 15% of shipments turn out to be larger than the sender claimed, catching those differences is worth about $50k per site per month in rebillings and improved trailer utilization. The startup is based in San Francisco, employs a team of three, and is currently active.

_Usage:_

"How does transload detect oversized shipments using existing security cameras?"

"Transload captures the true size of shipments as they move through the warehouse using the security cameras already installed. It then compares the measured dimensions to the sender's declared size, flagging any discrepancies. This allows logistics companies to catch 15% of oversized shipments, which can be worth about $50k per site per month in rebillings and better trailer utilization."

nodes.title: Trellis
nodes.description: AI agents that manage short-term rental operations end-to-end. YC Sp26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://trellistech.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/trellistech

Trellis is building a hospitality platform where AI agents operate short-term rental properties rather than just helping guests find them. The company targets property managers by replacing fragmented tools for guest messaging, tasks, cleaning, maintenance, and owner updates with a unified agent-driven system.

Based in San Francisco, the five-person team has grown to $500k ARR across 35 customers and 3,000 listings in two months. The company reports 15% week-over-week growth and notes that at least one customer is already running day-to-day operations with no human involvement.

_Usage:_

"How does Trellis handle the operational complexity of short-term rentals compared to traditional property management software?"

"Instead of providing a dashboard for humans to manage tasks, Trellis uses agents to execute the operations end-to-end. This means the system directly handles guest messages, coordinates cleaners and maintenance vendors, and updates owners, effectively replacing the fragmented stack of manual tools with autonomous workflows."

nodes.body:

The company has sold $1.6 million worth of systems to the Department of War, delivering multiple units to the agency. Its flagship product, EDDA, is a small, low-power, and low-cost system designed to be deployed on vehicles, bases, or carried by personnel to intercept Group 1 suicide drones.

With a team of 19, 9 Mothers has secured multiple contracts and sales for its autonomous-capable hardware. Beyond its initial product, the company is developing three additional systems that are currently in various stages of development to meet ongoing demand in the defense sector.

_Usage:_

"What makes the EDDA system different from traditional high-end counter-drone solutions?"

"EDDA is designed to be small, low-power, and low-cost, allowing it to be fully autonomous and deployed on vehicles, bases, or carried by individuals. This contrasts with larger, more expensive systems, making it a practical option for stopping Group 1 suicide drones in diverse operational environments."

nodes.title: Clara
nodes.description: AI primary care and longevity practice that acts on patient medical data. YC Sp26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://askclara.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/clara-2

Clara operates as an AI primary care and longevity practice, founded by the team that previously built Circle Medical to $100M in revenue. The company aims to extend human healthspan by deploying an AI system with deep clinical knowledge that analyzes medical data to detect subtle trends and patterns.

Unlike general-purpose chatbots, Clara integrates directly with patient medical records to perform actions such as managing medication refills, ordering labs, and interpreting symptoms. While the AI handles initial interactions and recommendations, a human medical provider reviews and approves all clinical decisions before they are finalized. The nine-person team is based in San Francisco.

_Usage:_

"How does Clara differ from using a general LLM like ChatGPT for medical questions?"

"General LLMs can only provide text-based advice based on your description, whereas Clara has direct access to your actual medical data. This allows it to detect longitudinal trends and execute specific actions like ordering labs or processing refills, though a human doctor still reviews the final recommendations."

nodes.title: NuCypher (aka Threshold Network)
nodes.description: Pioneering decentralized threshold cryptography and end-to-end encrypted data sharing networks. YC S16.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://threshold.network/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/nucypher-aka-threshold-network

NuCypher, also known as the Threshold Network, is a B2B infrastructure company based in Austin, Texas, that specializes in decentralized threshold cryptography. Since 2017, the team has developed cryptographic primitives for secure data sharing, including Proxy Re-Encryption and Threshold Access Control (TACo), alongside novel cryptoeconomic mechanisms like Stable Yield.

The company’s flagship product, TACo, launched on mainnet in January 2024 and is currently running on over 120 nodes with approximately $80 million in associated economic security. It supports a growing ecosystem of paying developers and major infrastructure partners such as Ceramic, Irys, Textile, and Unlock, maintaining a decentralized architecture from its genesis block.

As one of the two founding teams of the Threshold Network, NuCypher hosts several key protocols including tBTC, Random Beacon, and tUSD. The organization has also implemented original network and governance architectures, including a historic on-chain merger, to support its mission of enhancing privacy and security in decentralized systems.

_Usage:_

"How does TACo handle key management differently from traditional centralized encryption services?"

"TACo uses Threshold Access Control to allow for end-to-end encrypted data sharing without relying on a single point of failure or a central authority to hold keys. It operates on a decentralized network of over 120 nodes, meaning the cryptographic operations are distributed, which provides the security benefits of threshold cryptography while maintaining the flexibility needed for developers integrating with partners like Ceramic or Unlock."

nodes.description: a sandboxed environment for prototyping server-side JavaScript. YC S16.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://tonicdev.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/runkit

RunKit was a developer tool designed to streamline the prototyping of server-side JavaScript by removing the friction associated with testing new ideas. The platform provided a sandboxed environment where users could instantly switch Node versions and access any npm module without waiting for installations, while also offering visualization capabilities for results.

Based in San Francisco, the company operated as a small two-person team focused on B2B engineering and product design. RunKit was acquired.

_Usage:_

"How does RunKit handle dependencies compared to a standard local Node.js setup?"

"Instead of requiring you to run npm install for every package, RunKit provides a sandboxed environment where you can use any npm module instantly without waiting for installation. It also allows you to switch Node versions on the fly, which is much faster than managing local environments or Docker containers for quick prototyping."

nodes.title: CrowdAI

nodes.body:
**Website:** https://crowdai.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/crowdai

CrowdAI provides a no-code platform that enables enterprises to leverage deep learning for real-time visual decision-making. By treating data as the new code, the company offers infrastructure for the entire AI lifecycle, allowing users to systematically label data, train models efficiently, and scale them iteratively.

The platform is designed to be accessible to a wide range of technical abilities, from business operators to data scientists. CrowdAI was acquired.

_Usage:_

"How does CrowdAI differ from standard ML frameworks for computer vision tasks?"

"CrowdAI focuses on a no-code interface that covers the full AI lifecycle, including data labeling, model training, and deployment, rather than just providing a coding framework. This allows non-technical business operators to build and manage vision AI models without writing code, whereas standard frameworks typically require significant engineering effort to set up the data pipeline and training infrastructure."

nodes.title: Bulldozair
nodes.description: Bulldozair is a collaborative platform that helps companies manage construction projects on time and on budget. YC S16.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.bulldozair.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/bulldozair

Bulldozair provides a web and mobile platform designed to help organizations with real estate or industrial assets deliver construction projects efficiently. The company digitally integrates the entire construction process, including compliance and checklists, delivering these tasks directly to contractors and engineering teams. By using a mobile application, field teams collect data such as forms, measurements, and pictures, which are uploaded directly to the collaborative platform.

The system allows users to track project progress via a dashboard and receive alerts for potential delays or technical risks. All communication between stakeholders is archived for traceability, and legal and contractual reporting that previously took weeks is now automated. Bulldozair was acquired.

Based in Paris, France, the company was backed by Y Combinator, Station F, and Kima Ventures. It serves major corporate clients in infrastructure construction, manufacturing, energy, and retail, operating with a team of eight.

_Usage:_

"How does Bulldozair handle field data and reporting compared to traditional methods?"

"It replaces manual, week-long legal and contractual reporting with automated processes by having field teams upload data like forms, measurements, and pictures directly from a mobile app to a central dashboard. This ensures all stakeholder communication is archived for traceability and alerts users to potential delays or technical risks in real-time, rather than relying on delayed manual updates."

nodes.title: NeoWize
nodes.description: Develops machine learning algorithms that generate synthetic data to improve predictive power for e-commerce personalization. YC S16.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://www.neowize.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/neowize

NeoWize developed a novel machine learning approach that utilizes neural networks and adaptive input to create more and better data, specifically designed to enhance predictive power when working with small datasets. By changing how deep learning algorithms handle data availability, the company aimed to increase the effectiveness of models in data-scarce environments.

The technology was applied to help e-commerce sites understand individual buyer preferences, enabling the creation of a superior user experience from the very first visit. As a B2B retail solution, NeoWize focused on personalization to drive engagement for online stores.

The company, based in Tel Aviv, Israel, was acquired.

_Usage:_

"How does NeoWize handle the problem of limited user data on new e-commerce sites?"

"Instead of relying solely on the limited historical data available from a new visitor, NeoWize uses neural networks and adaptive input to generate additional synthetic data. This process creates a richer dataset that improves the predictive power of the model, allowing the site to personalize the experience more effectively from the first visit rather than waiting for enough real-world interactions to accumulate."

nodes.title: CareRev
nodes.description: Connecting healthcare facilities with local clinical talent to build a flexible workforce. YC S16.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.carerev.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/carerev

CareRev operates as a technology platform that connects healthcare facilities directly with local clinical professionals. By removing traditional staffing agencies from the equation, the company enables healthcare workers to choose where and when they work while giving facilities access to a resilient, flexible local workforce.

Founded in the Summer 2016 YC batch, CareRev has grown to a team of 275 employees operating primarily remotely. The company was acquired.

_Usage:_

"How does CareRev differ from traditional healthcare staffing agencies?"

"CareRev acts as a direct marketplace between facilities and clinicians, effectively cutting out the middleman. Instead of relying on third-party agencies to source talent, it provides a direct line for healthcare professionals to find shifts that fit their schedules, which allows facilities to access local clinical talent more efficiently."

nodes.body:

nodes.title: PatientBank
nodes.description: A platform for gathering and sharing medical records online from any provider. YC S16.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.patientbank.us | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/patientbank

PatientBank was a healthcare technology company that enabled individuals to consolidate and share their medical records online, regardless of which doctor or hospital generated the data. The startup operated out of New York City and San Francisco with a small team of two employees.

Backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, and Khosla Ventures, PatientBank aimed to solve the fragmentation of patient health data. The company has since shut down and is currently inactive.

_Usage:_

"How did PatientBank handle the technical challenge of pulling records from disparate hospital systems?"

"PatientBank focused on the user experience of aggregation rather than detailing specific interoperability protocols in the provided text. It allowed users to request records from any provider, effectively acting as a centralized portal for personal health data, though the underlying method for fetching data from various EHRs is not specified in the directory entry."

nodes.title: BillionToOne
nodes.description: Develops a DNA molecular counter that enhances cell-free DNA diagnostics resolution for prenatal screening and cancer liquid biopsy. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.billiontoone.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/billiontoone

BillionToOne is a public healthcare company based in San Francisco and Menlo Park that has developed a DNA molecular counter to increase cell-free DNA diagnostics resolution by over 1,000 fold. This technology enables transformative improvements in prenatal screening and liquid biopsy for cancers, allowing for more precise detection and measurement of disease.

The company’s flagship product, Unity Screen, is a commercially available non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT) that assesses fetal risk for both recessive conditions and aneuploidies from maternal blood. It is noted as the only NIPT capable of evaluating both types of risks simultaneously, with publications highlighting its accuracy and advantages over other screening methods. BillionToOne has also applied its molecular counting technology to develop liquid biopsy tests aimed at transforming oncology care.

_Usage:_

"How does BillionToOne’s molecular counter differ from standard NIPTs in terms of what it can detect?"

"Standard NIPTs typically focus on aneuploidies, but BillionToOne’s Unity Screen uses a DNA molecular counter to boost resolution by over 1,000 fold. This allows it to be the only NIPT that can assess fetal risk for both recessive conditions and aneuploidies from maternal blood, providing a broader diagnostic scope than other screening methods."

nodes.title: Flock Safety
nodes.description: A public safety operating system using AI-powered devices to help law enforcement eliminate crime. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://www.flocksafety.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/flock-safety

Flock Safety provides a public safety operating system that empowers private communities and law enforcement to collaborate in eliminating crime. The company offers a Safety-as-a-Service model featuring affordable, LTE and solar-powered devices that can be installed anywhere to detect and capture objective details. These devices decode evidence in real-time and deliver investigative leads directly to relevant public servants.

Headquartered in Atlanta with a team of approximately 1,000 employees, Flock Safety operates nationwide. The company emphasizes ethical design to protect human privacy and mitigate bias in policing. It raised $150M in a Series E round led by Tiger Global at a $3.5B valuation.

_Usage:_

"How does the hardware deployment work compared to traditional surveillance setups?"

"The system uses standalone devices powered by LTE and solar energy, which allows for installation in almost any location without the need for complex wiring or infrastructure. Once installed, the devices use machine learning to detect events and capture objective details, decoding evidence in real-time to send investigative leads to law enforcement."

nodes.title: Modern Fertility
nodes.description: At-home fertility testing and personalized reproductive health insights for women. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.modernfertility.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/modern-fertility

Modern Fertility is a women’s health company that makes personalized reproductive health information more accessible earlier in life. It offers at-home laboratory tests that were previously confined to fertility clinics, allowing women to gain powerful insights into their reproductive health from the comfort of their own homes.

The company aims to close the fertility information gap by empowering women to own the decisions impacting their bodies and futures. Based in San Francisco, the team of 25 has raised $22 million from investors including Forerunner Ventures, Maveron, Union Square Ventures, First Round Capital, and Y Combinator.

Modern Fertility was acquired.

_Usage:_

"How does Modern Fertility differ from traditional fertility clinic visits?"

"Modern Fertility brings the same laboratory tests typically performed in fertility clinics to the user's home. This removes the need for in-person appointments and makes personalized reproductive health data more accessible for women who may not be ready for children yet but want to understand their options earlier."

nodes.title: Thematic
nodes.description: Customer intelligence layer for enterprise CX teams providing traceable reporting and grounded data for AI agents. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://www.getthematic.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/thematic

Thematic provides a customer intelligence layer designed specifically for enterprise customer experience teams. It focuses on delivering trustworthy and traceable reporting that allows organizations to make high-stakes decisions based on solid data. The platform also serves as a grounded data foundation, enabling AI agents to scale safely within existing business operations.

The company reports significant performance improvements for its users, including NPS gains of 5 to 35 points. In one specific case, a customer attributed $4.8M in revenue to a six-month pilot. Independent analysis by Forrester measured a three-year ROI of 543% for the platform.

Thematic is a B2B SaaS company with a team of 20 people, operating remotely and out of Auckland, New Zealand. It is trusted by major enterprise clients such as DoorDash, Woolworths, BNY, and Mitsubishi.

_Usage:_

"How does Thematic differ from standard analytics dashboards when it comes to integrating with AI agents?"

"Unlike traditional dashboards that often provide opaque metrics, Thematic emphasizes traceability and grounding. It acts as a data foundation specifically structured so that AI agents can operate safely and reliably, ensuring that the insights generated are trustworthy enough for enterprise decision-making."

nodes.title: Gem
nodes.description: A talent engagement platform that unifies recruiting data and automates outreach to improve hiring speed and quality. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.gem.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/gem

Gem is a San Francisco-based talent engagement platform designed to help recruiting teams leverage data and automation for faster, higher-quality, and more diverse hiring. By integrating data from email, applicant tracking systems, LinkedIn, and other social networks, the platform creates a unified source of truth for all talent relationships. This allows teams to gain insights into the entire recruiting process and plan strategically for future hiring needs.

The company serves savvy recruiting teams at major organizations, including Wayfair, Dropbox, Nasdaq, Cisco, and DoorDash. These customers utilize Gem’s cross-functional collaboration tools and automated outreach capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage in talent acquisition. With a team of approximately 200 people, Gem continues to operate as an active B2B SaaS provider in the recruiting and talent industry.

_Usage:_

"How does Gem handle the data fragmentation problem that recruiters face when using multiple tools?"

"Gem solves this by unifying data and context from the various tools recruiters already use daily, such as email, applicant tracking systems, and LinkedIn. Instead of switching between disparate platforms, the system aggregates this information into a single source of truth for talent relationships, enabling teams to automate outreach at scale and collaborate more effectively across functions."

nodes.title: May Mobility
nodes.description: Deploying autonomous shuttle technology to enhance public transit in urban and rural areas. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://maymobility.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/may-mobility

May Mobility focuses on the development and deployment of autonomous vehicle technology, specifically designing safe and efficient shuttle solutions that complement existing public transportation options. Based in Ann Arbor, MI, the company has accumulated over 300,000 autonomous rides to date, positioning itself as a leader in the field.

The company aims to make transportation more accessible and reliable while improving road safety and encouraging better land use. By fostering more green, vibrant, and livable spaces, May Mobility seeks to transform both cities and rural areas through its self-driving systems.

With a team of approximately 260 employees, the organization operates at the intersection of industrials, automotive, and robotics, leveraging artificial intelligence to drive sustainable mobility solutions.

_Usage:_

"May Mobility focuses on shuttle solutions designed to complement public transportation rather than replacing private cars or offering on-demand rides for individuals. Their goal is to make transit more accessible and reliable in both urban and rural settings, emphasizing safety and sustainable land use over the typical point-to-point consumer ride experience."

nodes.title: D-ID
nodes.description: Generates realistic AI personas and video reenactments via deep learning APIs. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://www.d-id.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/d-id

D-ID is a Tel Aviv-based startup established in 2017 that specializes in patented video reenactment technology using AI and deep learning. The company enables creators and developers to generate realistic, high-quality AI personas through its platform and APIs, aiming to facilitate what it terms Creative Reality.

Its product suite ranges from animating still photos to facilitating high-quality video productions and creating viral user experiences. Notably, D-ID created the first facial image de-identification solution designed to protect images and videos from facial recognition software, reflecting its focus on ethical AI usage alongside creative tools.

With a team of 27, the company operates in the B2B and security sectors, leveraging generative AI to serve both entertainment and privacy-focused applications.

_Usage:_

"How does D-ID's video reenactment differ from standard face-swapping tools, and what is the de-identification feature for?"

"D-ID uses patented deep learning technology to animate still photos into realistic AI personas, allowing developers to build video productions and viral experiences via API. It also offers a facial image de-identification solution that modifies images to prevent them from being recognized by facial recognition software, providing a privacy layer alongside its generative capabilities."

nodes.title: UpCodes
nodes.description: AI platform unifying building codes, assemblies, products, and specs for construction professionals. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://up.codes/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/upcodes

UpCodes simplifies code compliance for architects, engineers, and construction professionals by providing a centralized, searchable library of over 6,000 state and city building codes. The company uses natural language processing to parse complex code adoptions across U.S. jurisdictions, enabling teams to navigate construction regulations more efficiently.

The platform powers the first AI-driven code-to-spec workflow, connecting regulations directly to specifications and a growing product library. It also offers an AI solution for building product manufacturers, allowing them to showcase compliant products and reach design professionals at the moment of specification.

With 800,000 monthly active users, UpCodes has demonstrated strong product-led growth in transforming how construction teams handle regulatory compliance. The company is based in Austin, Texas, and operates with a remote-friendly team of 35.

_Usage:_

"How does UpCodes handle the complexity of different building codes across various U.S. jurisdictions?"

"It uses NLP to parse complex code adoptions across more than 6,000 state and city building codes, allowing users to search and navigate regulations in a centralized library rather than manually checking individual jurisdictional documents."

nodes.title: disclosures.io
nodes.description: A listing toolkit that digitizes real estate disclosures to speed up home sales. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://disclosures.io | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/disclosures-io

Disclosures.io builds a complete listing toolkit designed to modernize the residential real estate transaction process. By focusing on the disclosure phase, the platform helps sellers get their homes to market faster while enabling buyers to make more informed offers. The company operates in San Francisco with a team of ten, addressing a sector where digital adoption has historically lagged behind other industries.

The company was founded on the belief that lean, pragmatic product development could improve transparency and efficiency in a high-volume market. Its approach targets the pain points of traditional home buying and selling, aiming to streamline the exchange of critical property information. Disclosures.io was acquired.

_Usage:_

"How does this toolkit actually change the workflow for a seller compared to using a standard MLS template?"

"It streamlines the disclosure process by providing a dedicated toolkit that helps sellers get their home to market faster. Instead of manually managing these documents, the platform enables a more efficient exchange of information, which in turn allows buyers to make more informed offers without the typical delays associated with traditional real estate paperwork."

nodes.title: Headstart
nodes.description: Uses machine learning to help employers screen candidates based on personality, behaviors, and strengths rather than traditional qualifications. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.headstart.io | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/headstart

Headstart is a London-based recruiting technology platform that uses machine learning to streamline talent acquisition. Instead of relying solely on traditional resume qualifications or past work experience, the platform evaluates applicants on personality, behaviors, strengths, and motivations to create an inclusive screening process.

For candidates, the system relies on a reusable 15-minute application form that connects job seekers directly with hiring businesses. Employers leverage these insights to identify candidates who align with their exact job requirements, culture, and values earlier in the hiring funnel.

The Summer 2017 Y Combinator company grew to a team of 44 people and has since been acquired.

_Usage:_

"How does Headstart evaluate candidates differently than standard keyword resume screeners?"

"Headstart shifts away from qualification- and experience-based filtering by using machine learning to assess applicants on personality, behaviors, strengths, and motivations. Candidates complete a reusable 15-minute application form, giving employers a way to match applicants to specific job requirements and company culture earlier in the hiring pipeline."

nodes.title: Feather
nodes.description: Feather rents furniture to consumers and businesses, letting users pay monthly toward ownership or swap items. YC S17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://livefeather.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/feather

Feather offers a furniture rental service for city dwellers and businesses, allowing customers to pay monthly fees that can be applied toward ownership or to swap out pieces as needs change. The company’s refurbishment process gives returned items a new life, and its reverse‑logistics platform lets users add or replace furniture on demand, keeping more pieces in homes and out of landfills. Feather was acquired, bringing its 125‑person team based in New York City and San Francisco under a larger umbrella.

_Usage:_

"How does Feather’s reverse‑logistics platform differ from traditional furniture rental models?"

"Unlike many rental services that only offer a fixed inventory, Feather’s platform lets customers swap or add new pieces at any time; returned items are refurbished and re‑sent to new homes, which reduces waste and keeps furniture circulating."

nodes.body:
**Website:** https://momentus.space | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/momentus

Momentus is a space infrastructure services company that positions itself as a first mover, offering foundational services that enable businesses to flourish in space.
With an experienced team of aerospace, propulsion, and robotics engineers, Momentus designs and operates cost‑effective and energy‑efficient in‑space transport and service vehicles that utilize water plasma propulsion technology.
The company has secured service agreements with numerous private satellite operators, government agencies, and research organizations, and it is a public company.

"Momentus's water plasma propulsion uses water as propellant, generating thrust through plasma generation, which is more energy‑efficient and cost‑effective than traditional chemical rockets, allowing it to operate in‑space vehicles with lower mass and fuel requirements."

nodes.title: Rejuvenation Technologies Inc.
nodes.description: Rejuvenation Technologies Inc. develops mRNA therapeutics to extend healthspan. YC S18.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.rejuvenationtech.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/rejuvenation-technologies-inc

Rejuvenation Technologies Inc. uses a Stanford‑patented mRNA platform to unlock healthspan by targeting short telomeres. In preclinical studies the therapy reversed 5‑10 years of telomere shortening with a single dose in one day and extended mouse lifespan by the equivalent of 10 human years, showing efficacy in four organ systems including the immune system.

The company has 50+ granted patents, was cleared by FDA INTERACT, and is currently raising a $10M seed extension to fund three investigator‑initiated trials with readouts expected in Q3 2027.

nodes.title: Rain Neuromorphics
nodes.description: Rain Neuromorphics builds artificial intelligence processors inspired by the brain. YC S18.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://www.rain-neuromorphics.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/rain-neuromorphics

Rain Neuromorphics develops neuromorphic hardware that mimics the brain's structure, building a physical artificial neural network composed of spiking neurons and physical synapses. It combines electroceramic materials, nanofabrication techniques, and biologically plausible learning models to create the Memristive Nanowire Neural Network (MN3). The MN3 can host over ten million spiking neurons per square centimeter and consumes far less power than conventional GPUs and CPUs, making it attractive for industrial, manufacturing, and robotics applications that require power efficiency and continuous learning. Rain Neuromorphics was founded in Summer 2018, has a team of 12, and operates out of San Francisco and Redwood City, CA. The company was acquired.

_Usage:_

"How does Rain Neuromorphics' MN3 compare to conventional GPUs in terms of power consumption?"

"The MN3 uses far less power than conventional GPUs and CPUs while supporting over ten million spiking neurons per square centimeter."

nodes.description: Regology builds AI agents that streamline regulatory compliance. YC S18.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://regology.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/regology

Regology is an AI‑powered regulatory intelligence platform that helps compliance, legal, risk, and operations teams navigate complex regulatory environments across U.S. federal, state, and global jurisdictions.

At its core, the Smart Law Library™ offers a curated, continuously updated repository of applicable laws and regulations, and three specialized AI agents drive the platform: the Regulatory Change Agent tracks and alerts on jurisdiction‑specific developments; the Compliance Agent maps changes to policies, controls, and risks; and the Regulatory Research Agent delivers plain‑language summaries, multi‑jurisdictional comparisons, and actionable insights.

Regology was acquired and now operates with a team of 60 in San Francisco, CA, serving B2B legal clients.

_Usage:_

"What is the difference between Regology's Regulatory Change Agent and its Compliance Agent?"

"The Regulatory Change Agent tracks and alerts on jurisdiction‑specific developments, while the Compliance Agent maps those changes to internal policies, controls, and risks."

nodes.title: Allotrope Medical
nodes.description: Advancing surgical precision through safe electrical stimulation. YC S18.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://www.allotropemed.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/allotrope-medical

Allotrope Medical is a Houston-based medical device company founded and run by the surgeon that created the technology. Its platform stimulation technology gives physicians control over the natural movements of the urinary and digestive systems, enabling surgeons to identify hidden anatomic structures such as ureters and sphincters, assess tissue health, and assist in diagnosing disease states. The technology is delivered through the surgeon's existing instruments, which have remained unchanged for over 30 years, providing a new capability while maintaining seamless workflow integration.
Allotrope Medical was acquired, and its 2‑person team continues to focus on integrating the stimulation platform into existing surgical instruments. With an initial market of $600M, the technology is future‑proof and can be readily integrated into continued advancements in the surgical space.

_Usage:_

"How does Allotrope’s stimulation platform improve identification of hidden structures compared to standard surgical tools?"

"Allotrope’s platform provides real‑time control over smooth muscle movements, allowing surgeons to map ureters, sphincters, and other structures that are otherwise invisible, whereas standard tools lack this dynamic electrical stimulation capability."

nodes.title: Glimpse
nodes.description: Glimpse automates back‑office workflows for CPG brands, recovering revenue and boosting margins. YC S20.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://tryglimpse.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/glimpse-2

Glimpse is the leading AI platform for CPG brands, automating key back‑office workflows such as deductions management, revenue recovery, and cash application to increase operating leverage and return millions of dollars to a brand's pocket.

Its agents automatically retrieve deduction data, validate charges, automate cash application, and dispute invalid claims, often starting with a lookback of the past year of deductions. For a $1B CPG, one agent reviewed 17,000 deductions in under 24 hours—work that would take an FTE roughly two years—and identified more than $10 million in recoverable revenue, driving meaningful margin expansion.

Glimpse’s pricing is simple and incentive‑aligned, structured to create clear P&L impact from day one. The company is based in New York City, employs 27 people, and serves the B2B retail sector.

_Usage:_

"What back‑office tasks does Glimpse automate?"

"It automatically retrieves deduction data, validates charges, automates cash application, and disputes invalid claims to recover lost revenue."

Nephrogen is a Stanford biotech spin‑out focused on curative gene therapies for kidney and pancreatic diseases, conditions that affect 1 in 7 Americans and lack approved gene‑based treatments. nodes.title: Kernal Biologics
nodes.description: Kernal creates mRNA 2.0 therapies that target specific cells. YC S20.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.kernalbio.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/kernal-biologics

Kernal Bio is a biotech company pioneering mRNA 2.0 immunotherapies. It leverages selective mRNA‑LNP technology to treat cancer and autoimmune diseases with precision, ensuring targeted cell delivery and minimal off‑target effects.

Its KR‑402 program achieves over 90% delivery efficiency with T‑cell‑targeted LNPs, enabling direct CAR‑T programming within the body and resulting in B‑cell depletion within a week. Kernal Bio holds three FDA‑approved therapies and more than 120 patents, and is backed by Hummingbird Ventures, Amgen Ventures, HBM, and NASA.

Based in Cambridge, MA, Kernal Bio’s team of 20 draws on experience from MIT, Harvard, Merck, and BMS. Leadership includes CEO Yusuf Erkul, President Burak Yilmaz, and Sr. VP of R&D Manfred Kraus, all of whom have a track record in drug discovery and immuno‑oncology.

_Usage:_

"What makes Kernal's mRNA‑2.0 platform distinct from other mRNA therapies?"

"Kernal’s platform uses selective mRNA‑LNP technology that targets specific cell types, achieving over 90% delivery efficiency with T‑cell‑targeted LNPs. This allows direct CAR‑T programming in vivo and rapid B‑cell depletion within a week, while minimizing off‑target effects."

nodes.title: Warmly,
nodes.description: Autonomous sales platform that identifies warm leads and auto-follows up via chat, email, and LinkedIn. YC S20.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.warmly.ai/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/warmly

Warmly, is an autonomous sales orchestration platform designed to identify and engage warm leads. It utilizes data from sources like 6sense, Clearbit, and Bombora to find contacts and companies showing interest in a user's website or researching them online but who have not yet converted. Once these leads are identified, the platform automatically follows up via chat, email, or LinkedIn, allowing users to set up specific workflows for AI-driven interactions while retaining the ability for human verification before messages are sent.

The company claims its autonomous approach yields ten times more outbound activity than a human SDR and three times higher reply rates due to the warmth of the leads. Warmly, also offers options for human-in-the-loop engagement, such as one-click warm intro requests or live video calls. The San Francisco-based team, which includes remote workers, served over 100 paying customers before being acquired by HubSpot in 2026.

_Usage:_

"How does Warmly, handle lead qualification compared to standard SDR workflows?"

"It automates the initial outreach by identifying warm leads through third-party data providers and then executing follow-up sequences via chat, email, or LinkedIn. While it claims to generate ten times more outbound volume than a human SDR with higher reply rates, the system allows for human verification of messages before they are sent, giving teams a safety net against fully autonomous errors."

nodes.title: Nestybox
nodes.description: Enables Linux containers to act as super fast and efficient virtual machines. YC S20.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.nestybox.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/nestybox

Nestybox develops software that allows Linux containers to function like virtual machines, offering enterprises a more flexible and cost-effective alternative to traditional VMs. Its primary product, Sysbox, is a container runtime that integrates with popular orchestration engines like Docker and Kubernetes, enabling these platforms to deploy containers with VM-like capabilities.

By providing an easier-to-use and highly efficient option that migrates easily across clouds, Nestybox expands the use cases for containerization. The company, based in San Francisco and San Jose, was acquired, marking its exit from the developer tools and infrastructure space.

_Usage:_

"How does Sysbox compare to running standard Docker containers or full VMs?"

"Sysbox acts as a container runtime that lets you run workloads inside containers that behave like virtual machines, giving you the isolation and compatibility of a VM with the speed and efficiency of a container. It integrates directly with Docker and Kubernetes, so you can deploy these VM-like containers using your existing orchestration tools without needing a separate hypervisor layer."

nodes.title: Aquarium Learning
nodes.description: Helps ML teams improve model performance by identifying and fixing dataset anomalies. YC S20.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.aquariumlearning.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/aquarium-learning

Aquarium Learning provides tooling that helps machine learning teams enhance their models by improving the quality and diversity of their training datasets. The platform allows teams to identify anomalies and failure patterns within their data, then edit or add specific data points to address these issues. By refining the underlying dataset, the company enables teams to achieve better results when they retrain their models.

The company operated in the B2B infrastructure space, focusing on developer tools for deep learning and generative AI. With a team of 12 based in San Francisco and remote locations, Aquarium Learning addressed the common challenge that model performance is often limited by the quality of the data used for training. The company was acquired, marking a significant milestone for this data-centric approach to ML optimization.

_Usage:_

"How does Aquarium Learning actually improve model performance without changing the model architecture?"

"It focuses on the data side of the equation by scanning your training sets for anomalies and failure patterns. Instead of tweaking hyperparameters, you use the tool to edit or add specific data points that address those identified weaknesses, so the next time you retrain, the model performs better because the input data is cleaner and more diverse."

nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.vectrix.io | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/vectrix

Vectrix provides security scanning for SaaS applications, helping organizations identify risks such as public document sharing, missing two-factor authentication, and weak password policies across platforms like Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, and Zoom. The tool allows IT and security teams to monitor their entire SaaS suite and receive real-time alerts when new security issues arise.

Founded by former security professionals from Autodesk, Vimeo, and PlanGrid, the company was based in San Francisco with a team of seven. Vectrix was acquired, marking the end of its independent operation.

_Usage:_

"How does Vectrix differ from traditional endpoint security tools?"

"Vectrix focuses specifically on the configuration and usage of cloud-based SaaS apps rather than local endpoints. It scans for issues like who has access to sensitive documents or if 2FA is disabled in Zoom, providing a view of security posture across the entire SaaS stack that traditional antivirus or endpoint detection tools do not cover."

nodes.title: Known Medicine
nodes.description: Uses patient-specific 3D cell culture and AI to identify optimal drug treatments for oncology. YC S20.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://knownmed.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/known-medicine

Known Medicine combines patient-specific 3D cell culture with AI to translate drugs to clinical success. The company receives patient tumors, breaks them down, and creates thousands of micro-tumors to test various drug responses. By treating each micro-tumor with different drugs, it determines which treatments the patient will respond best to.

Based in Salt Lake City, Utah, the company operates in the healthcare industry with a team of 17. It was acquired, marking a significant milestone in its mission to improve oncology outcomes through personalized medicine.

_Usage:_

"How does Known Medicine's approach to drug testing differ from standard in-vitro methods?"

"Instead of using generic cell lines, Known Medicine takes a patient's actual tumor, breaks it down into thousands of micro-tumors, and tests different drugs on them. This allows them to use AI to predict which specific treatment that individual patient will respond to best, rather than relying on population-level averages."

nodes.body:
**Website:** https://strive.school | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/strive-school

Strive School operates a six-month online program designed to transform STEM students into professional-grade software engineers. The company addresses the gap between theoretical university curricula and industry requirements by providing practical, job-ready training for those pursuing science and technology fields in Europe.

The platform utilizes an income share agreement model, where students pay a portion of their future salary in exchange for access to the curriculum. This approach allows candidates to defer costs until they are employed, aligning the company's success with the career outcomes of its graduates.

Strive School was acquired, marking a significant milestone for the Berlin-based team. The company, which maintains a small remote-first team, focused on the intersection of education and fintech to modernize software engineering training in the European market.

_Usage:_

"How does the payment model for Strive School differ from traditional bootcamps or university tuition?"

"Instead of requiring upfront tuition, Strive School uses an income share agreement where students pay a percentage of their future salary after becoming employed. This shifts the financial risk from the student to the provider and ensures that the cost of training is directly tied to the student's success in landing a software engineering role, which is a distinct model from the standard flat-fee structures common in most coding bootcamps."

nodes.title: Hypermile
nodes.description: Retrofittable AI cruise control for commercial vehicles that optimizes speed to reduce fuel consumption and extend electric range. YC S20.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://hypermile.ai | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/hypermile

Hypermile develops an AI driver assistance system designed to improve the efficiency, sustainability, and safety of trucking operations. The company addresses the high cost of fuel, which accounts for over a third of logistics operating costs, by deploying a retrofittable AI cruise control called Hypermile Co-Pilot. This system learns optimal driving techniques, such as anticipating traffic flow and maximizing vehicle coasting, to reduce diesel consumption by 11% and extend the range of battery-electric vehicles by 15%.

Based in London, the team of 11 engineers and product specialists builds hardware and software solutions for heavy goods vehicles. The company has received R&D grants from Innovate UK, the Department for Transport, and Horizons 2020. Its long-term vision includes building higher levels of autonomy, with the next milestone being a Level-3 autonomous trucking solution.

Hypermile was acquired, marking a significant exit for the company founded in May 2020.

_Usage:_

"How does Hypermile Co-Pilot differ from standard adaptive cruise control systems in terms of fuel savings?"

"Unlike standard adaptive cruise control, which primarily maintains a safe distance from the vehicle ahead, Hypermile’s AI system actively optimizes speed based on road gradient, traffic flow anticipation, and coasting opportunities. This approach allows the system to reduce diesel consumption by 11% and extend the range of electric trucks by 15%, addressing the specific inefficiencies in heavy goods vehicle operations that standard systems do not target."

nodes.title: Command AI
nodes.description: An AI-powered user assistance platform that combines an autonomous agent with a nudge system to improve product adoption and reduce support tickets. YC S20.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://command.ai | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/command-ai

Command AI provides a user assistance platform designed to make software interfaces more intuitive for visitors and customers. The company offers two primary tools: an AI Agent that answers questions, performs actions, and co-browses with users to teach them the interface, and a Nudge Platform that delivers personalized hints and messages based on in-product behavior rather than static rules.

The Nudge Platform is positioned as a replacement for legacy Digital Adoption Platforms, using data on user behavior and 'rage close' metrics to ensure guidance is helpful rather than annoying. By translating user assistance into concrete outcomes like improved engagement, feature adoption, and retention, the platform also helps decrease low-value support tickets.

Based in San Francisco, the company was acquired after serving a team of 35 employees. Its clients include HubSpot, HashiCorp, Yotpo, Thryvv, and Freshworks.

_Usage:_

"How does Command AI's Nudge Platform differ from traditional Digital Adoption Platforms (DAPs)?"

"Traditional DAPs often rely on static rules to display tooltips or guides, which can feel generic or annoying. Command AI's Nudge Platform uses AI to deliver personalized hints based on real-time in-product behavior. It also actively measures the extent to which users 'rage close' nudges, allowing the system to adjust its delivery to avoid pestering users, effectively replacing the rigid rule-based approach of legacy tools."

nodes.description: Open-source customer data platform for collecting event data from any source into your warehouse. YC S20.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://jitsu.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/jitsu

Jitsu is an open-source customer data platform (CDP) designed to collect event data from diverse sources, including web, app, email, chatbots, and CRMs, and route it directly into a data warehouse. The company describes its solution as the fastest and most durable method for this data ingestion, emphasizing security and rapid deployment capabilities.

Founded in the Summer 2020 batch, the New York City-based team of four engineers built Jitsu as a 100% open-source alternative to proprietary analytics infrastructure. Its primary focus is on B2B analytics and data engineering, allowing companies to establish a secure, purpose-built data pipeline in minutes.

Jitsu has since been acquired by Helium Ventures, marking a significant milestone for the open-source analytics tool.

_Usage:_

"How does Jitsu handle data ingestion compared to traditional closed-source CDPs?"

"Jitsu operates as a 100% open-source CDP that ingests event data from various sources like web, apps, and CRMs directly into your existing data warehouse. Unlike proprietary platforms, it is designed to be purpose-built and secure, allowing you to set up the pipeline in minutes without vendor lock-in, which is particularly useful for teams that want full control over their data engineering stack."

nodes.title: Altro
nodes.description: Builds credit scores for underserved consumers using a $75 line of credit for subscriptions. YC S20.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://altro.io | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/altro

Altro is a fintech platform that enables users to build their credit history regardless of their background or previous access to financial tools. It targets the 68 million people in the US, primarily women and people of color, who have historically faced bias or lack of access in the credit market. The company operates out of Los Angeles and remotely with a team of 29.

The platform provides members with a $75 line of credit specifically designed to pay for existing subscriptions like Netflix, Hulu, and HelloFresh. By allowing users to make these routine payments through Altro, the company helps them establish a positive credit score using services they are already paying for. This approach aims to empower individuals who were previously denied credit to gain access to broader financial tools such as personal loans and mortgages.

Altro was acquired, marking a significant milestone for the company in the consumer finance space.

_Usage:_

"How does Altro actually help someone with no credit history build a score?"

"Altro gives you a $75 line of credit that you can only use for subscriptions you're already paying for, like streaming services or meal kits. By making these payments through the platform, you generate a positive payment history that gets reported to credit bureaus, effectively building your score without needing a traditional bank card or large loan."

nodes.description: Attendance tracking software for public schools and colleges. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.safermgmt.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/safer-management

Safer Management provides attendance tracking software to public school districts and colleges. The platform addresses the financial incentive for public schools to maintain high average daily attendance, which directly impacts their federal funding.

Founded in Dallas, Texas, the company was launched after the founder observed inefficiencies in the sign-in process while dropping off his children. The team has since expanded to serve 75 public schools and two colleges, generating annual recurring revenue of $621,000 with 82% margins. The company is currently profitable and operates on a pricing model that scales to $15 per student per year.

Safer Management targets a market of 70 million public school students in the United States, representing a $1.4 billion opportunity. The company utilizes artificial intelligence and machine learning tags to support its operations within the education sector.

_Usage:_

"How does Safer Management help schools secure federal funding?"

"Public schools receive federal funding based on their average daily attendance, so Safer Management’s software ensures accurate tracking to help districts capture the money they are entitled to. It streamlines the sign-in process, which was previously inefficient, allowing schools to maintain the attendance records necessary for funding eligibility."

The company aims to establish a foundation by selling space domain awareness imagery data while progressing toward asteroid mining capabilities. Its first DROID satellite was scheduled to launch in early 2023.

"They are building a dual-use platform that allows them to sell space domain awareness imagery data. This revenue stream supports the development of their core technology, which is being advanced toward an affordable solution for orbital debris removal and eventually asteroid mining."

nodes.title: Waterplan
nodes.description: Waterplan measures and mitigates climate-driven water risk for industrial sites using satellite imagery and operational data. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://waterplan.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/waterplan

Waterplan operates a climate platform designed to help companies measure, respond to, and monitor their changing water risks. By combining internal operational data with local water satellite imagery, the platform provides a continuously updated financial assessment of water exposure. This approach allows multinational clients such as Coca-Cola, Diageo, Colgate, and AB InBev to visualize their specific vulnerabilities in real-time.

The company offers tailored mitigation and adaptation strategies based on these assessments, ranging from conventional infrastructure upgrades to nature-based solutions. Waterplan was founded by a team of second-time entrepreneurs with nearly a decade of experience working on water projects for Fortune 500 companies, bringing both technical and domain expertise to the challenge.

Based in San Francisco with a remote-capable team of 20, Waterplan has attracted investment from Y Combinator, Giant Ventures, and high-profile individuals including Leonardo DiCaprio and Richard Branson's family. The company is currently active and continues to serve the B2B climate tech sector.

_Usage:_

"How does Waterplan calculate water risk differently from standard environmental compliance tools?"

"Instead of relying solely on static regulatory reports, Waterplan merges a company's own operational data with live local water satellite imagery. This allows for a dynamic, continuously updated financial assessment of water risk rather than a one-time audit, enabling companies to see how their exposure changes over time and to identify specific adaptation opportunities like nature-based solutions."

nodes.title: Mach9
nodes.description: AI-powered CAD software that automates feature extraction for civil engineering and infrastructure projects. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.mach9.ai/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mach9

Mach9 develops automated feature extraction technology to accelerate how engineering teams model and understand the physical world. Its flagship platform, Digital Surveyor, is designed for transportation agencies, utility companies, and engineering firms to process miles of road corridor projects in a fraction of the time required by traditional methods.

Built on research from Carnegie Mellon University's Robotics Institute, the company applies computer vision and machine learning to create engineering-grade maps for infrastructure design and operations. The platform is used by leading survey and geospatial organizations, including Langan, Olsson, Woolpert, HDR, and major state DOTs, to tackle large-scale projects with greater speed and accuracy.

Founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, Mach9 operates with a team of 25 employees, focusing on the intersection of AI and the architecture, engineering, and construction industries.

_Usage:_

"How does Mach9's Digital Surveyor differ from standard GIS or CAD tools for infrastructure projects?"

"While traditional CAD and GIS tools often require manual digitization or extensive human input to map road corridors and infrastructure features, Mach9 uses automated feature extraction to process these datasets much faster. It generates engineering-grade maps from raw data, allowing firms to handle large-scale projects with less manual processing time while maintaining the accuracy needed for design and operations."

nodes.title: Writesonic
nodes.description: Tracks and boosts brand visibility across major AI search platforms like ChatGPT and Gemini. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://writesonic.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/writesonic

Writesonic operates as a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform designed to monitor brand visibility across more than ten AI search engines, including ChatGPT and Gemini. The tool provides specific actionable insights, suggesting strategies such as creating new content, refreshing existing pages, or identifying sites that mention competitors but exclude the user's brand.

Based in San Francisco with a remote-friendly team of 35, the company focuses on the B2B marketing sector. It has accumulated over 15,000 five-star reviews across platforms like G2, Trustpilot, and Capterra, reflecting its adoption in the evolving landscape of AI-driven search.

_Usage:_

"How does this differ from standard SEO tools?"

"Standard SEO tools track rankings on traditional search engines like Google, whereas Writesonic specifically tracks how often your brand is cited or mentioned within generative AI responses from platforms like ChatGPT and Gemini. It shifts the focus from keyword ranking to visibility within AI-generated answers, providing actions to improve that specific metric."

nodes.title: Verihubs
nodes.description: AI-powered deepfake detection and face recognition for fraud prevention in Southeast Asia. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://verihubs.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/verihubs

Verihubs is an Indonesian AI company specializing in automated and instant verification platforms, with a focus on deepfake detection and face recognition technology. The company has served over 300 clients in Southeast Asia, including major financial institutions such as BCA, IFG, Commonwealth Bank, and Maybank, as well as the Ministry of Finance.

Ranked #1 in Indonesia by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) for performance and accuracy, Verihubs positions its technology as a staple for fraud prevention in the region. The company operates out of Jakarta with a team of 63 employees, aiming to address the gap in verification solutions amid the rapid digital acceleration that the pandemic accelerated by 4-7 years.

_Usage:_

"How does Verihubs handle the specific threat of deepfakes in financial identity verification compared to standard biometric checks?"

"Verihubs uses AI-based face recognition technology specifically designed to detect deepfakes, which is critical for fraud prevention in digital banking and insurance. It has been ranked #1 in Indonesia by NIST for performance and accuracy, making it a trusted solution for institutions like BCA and the Ministry of Finance that need to verify identities in an era of accelerated digital adoption."

nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.mobileboost.io/yc | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mobileboost

MobileBoost provides AI-native mobile testing solutions designed to help engineering teams achieve higher test coverage faster. Its core product, GPT Driver, utilizes artificial intelligence to automate end-to-end mobile app testing, reducing the need for manual QA resources and tedious maintenance.

The platform aims to accelerate release cycles by providing reliable and consistent results, allowing teams to ship higher-quality applications. Notably, Duolingo has cited a partnership with MobileBoost that reduced their manual regression testing by 70%.

Based in Berlin with a remote team of 15, MobileBoost serves B2B clients in engineering and product design. The company is trusted by major industry leaders including Spotify, Netflix, Salesforce, and Groupon.

_Usage:_

"How does MobileBoost handle the flakiness issues common in traditional E2E mobile testing?"

"Instead of relying on brittle, hard-coded scripts that break with UI changes, MobileBoost uses its GPT Driver to automate testing via AI. This approach is designed to eliminate tedious maintenance and provide consistent results, as demonstrated by Duolingo’s report of reducing manual regression testing by 70%."

nodes.title: Instacrops
nodes.description: Instacrops provides IoT sensors and satellite analytics to help farmers in Latin America maximize crop yields. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.instacrops.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/instacrops

Instacrops operates a dashboard platform that combines data from IoT sensors, satellites, and drones to provide detailed analytics on farm health. The company is headquartered in Santiago, Chile, and employs a team of 34 people focused on bringing data-driven decision-making to the agricultural sector.

The platform is currently live on more than 300 farms across Latin America, where it has helped farmers increase their crop yields by an average of 12%. Instacrops has reached over $200,000 in monthly revenue with growth rates of 2X year-over-year.

The company targets the $50 billion agricultural market in Latin America, which encompasses 2.9 billion acres of farmland. By integrating physical hardware with remote sensing data, Instacrops aims to optimize farming operations across the region.

_Usage:_

"How does Instacrops actually measure crop health in the field?"

"It uses a combination of physical IoT sensors placed directly in the field alongside external data from satellites and drones. This multi-source approach allows the dashboard to provide comprehensive analytics on farm health, which users report leads to an average 12% increase in crop yield."

nodes.body:
**Website:** https://pipekit.io | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/pipekit

Pipekit is a remote-based infrastructure company that provides a management layer for Argo Workflows, an open-source pipeline framework for Kubernetes. The platform enables data teams to build complex data and CI pipelines more efficiently, claiming to reduce build times by half while saving enterprises hundreds of thousands of dollars annually.

The company maintains Argo Workflows, which is used in production by major organizations including Bloomberg, Intuit, Adobe, New Relic, and NVIDIA. Pipekit operates as a B2B developer tool focused on data engineering and DevOps, helping enterprises manage their pipeline infrastructure at scale.

_Usage:_

"How does Pipekit differ from just using Argo Workflows directly?"

"Pipekit acts as a managed application on top of Argo Workflows, which is the underlying open-source framework. nodes.title: Superwall
nodes.description: Subscription infrastructure and paywall experimentation platform for mobile apps. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://superwall.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/staffbar

Superwall provides a standalone subscription platform for consumer mobile and web applications, combining backend infrastructure with a no-code paywall and experimentation engine. The platform manages over $1.6 billion in annual subscription revenue across more than 10,000 apps, handling entitlements, purchase APIs with server-side receipt validation, and real-time revenue analytics. Notably, the infrastructure layer is free at any scale, with billing applied only to revenue generated through Superwall-rendered paywalls.

The company distinguishes itself by allowing high-revenue apps to run their entire subscription stack on Superwall alone, eliminating the need for a second backend. For example, the largest single app on the platform runs $43.7 million in annual recurring revenue entirely on Superwall. The platform supports Apple App Store, Google Play, and Stripe, covering various monetization models including auto-renewing subscriptions, free trials, and one-time purchases.

Superwall also offers extensive experimentation tools, having analyzed over 100 million paywall views and conducted more than 4,500 A/B tests. Its research indicates that multi-page onboarding paywalls can convert 37% better than single-page alternatives. Additionally, the company provides first-class tooling for AI coding agents, including open-source agent skills and an editor MCP server for building live paywalls from the terminal.

_Usage:_

"How does Superwall's pricing model differ from traditional subscription platforms that charge a percentage of total revenue?"

"Superwall charges 1% only on revenue attributed to its own paywalls, whereas traditional platforms often take a cut of all subscription revenue. This means if an app generates $50k/month in subscriptions but doesn't use Superwall's paywalls, it pays $0 for the platform. The infrastructure layer, including entitlements and receipt validation, is free at any scale, so the cost is strictly tied to the incremental revenue Superwall helps earn."
