nodes.title: Odys Aviation
nodes.description: Building vertical takeoff and landing aircraft to cut travel time in half on the world's busiest routes. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.odysaviation.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/odys-aviation

Odys Aviation, formerly known as Craft Aero, is developing vertical takeoff and landing aircraft specifically designed for major airlines. The company aims to reduce travel times by half on high-traffic routes by utilizing existing city helipads and local airports rather than relying solely on traditional long-haul infrastructure.

Based in Los Angeles, the team consists of 11 employees with backgrounds in electric propulsion and automotive manufacturing. The company has secured two USAF Agility Prime contracts and reports pre-orders and options for more than 1,000 aircraft, signaling significant early interest in its hard-tech aviation solutions.

_Usage:_

"How does Odys Aviation's approach to eVTOL differ from typical urban air mobility startups?"

"While many eVTOL companies focus on short-distance urban point-to-point travel, Odys Aviation targets major airlines and the world's busiest routes. The strategy involves using city helipads and local airports to cut travel time in half for longer distances, rather than just solving the last-mile problem within a single metro area."

nodes.title: Reframe
nodes.description: An app using neuroscience and psychology to help users reduce alcohol consumption without stigma. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.joinreframeapp.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/reframe

Reframe is a consumer health application designed to help individuals quit or cut back on alcohol use. It leverages principles from neuroscience and psychology to assist users in shifting their mindset regarding drinking and building sustainable habits. The company emphasizes a non-stigmatizing approach, focusing on behavioral change rather than strict restriction.

Based in Atlanta, Georgia, the company operates with a team of 35 people. It claims to be the leading app in this space, having supported over 2 million users in the past 12 months. Reframe states that it has helped more people reduce alcohol use than any other organization globally.

_Usage:_

"How does Reframe differ from traditional abstinence-based recovery programs?"

"Reframe focuses on harm reduction and habit formation using neuroscience and psychology, explicitly avoiding the stigma and rigid restrictions often associated with traditional abstinence-only models. It is designed for people who want to cut back on drinking rather than necessarily quit entirely, positioning itself as a tool for behavioral shift rather than just a support group."

nodes.title: Satsuma
nodes.description: Reliable blockchain indexing and querying for web3 engineering teams. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.satsuma.xyz/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/satsuma

Satsuma is a developer tool that enables teams to build applications on top of real-time blockchain data. It allows developers to ingest decoded data from multiple chains, customize it for specific use cases, and access it via API endpoints. The company operates on the premise that blockchains function as distributed databases for web3 products, but the current friction in accessing and querying this data is a significant blocker for mass adoption.

Founded in the Summer 2021 batch, Satsuma was built by a team of engineers with prior experience at Airtable, Heap, and Y Combinator. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with a remote-friendly culture and a small team of five. Satsuma was acquired, marking a notable exit for its infrastructure-focused approach to web3 data engineering.

_Usage:_

"How does Satsuma handle data from multiple blockchains for my application?"

"Satsuma acts as an indexing layer that takes decoded data from various chains, lets you customize the schema for your specific needs, and exposes it through standard API endpoints. This removes the complexity of managing raw blockchain queries directly, allowing your backend to treat on-chain data like a traditional database."

nodes.title: Verano Health
nodes.description: Nonprofit telehealth platform providing SMS-based diabetes coaching for Medicaid patients. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.veranohealth.org/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/verano-health

Verano Health operates as a nonprofit organization building a digital diabetes platform specifically for underserved Americans on Medicaid. The company addresses a significant gap in care where less than 1% of patients with diabetes receive necessary training, despite 30% or more of the 80 million Medicaid enrollees having chronic diseases.

The company utilizes a proven 'Healthy at Home' program that relies on two-way SMS interactions, weekly coaching visits, and evidence-based health education to support patients remotely. By billing health insurance for telehealth visits, Verano Health aims to achieve financial sustainability while expanding access to at-home chronic disease management.

Verano Health was acquired, marking the end of its independent operation as a startup entity.

_Usage:_

"How does Verano Health deliver care without a traditional app or video interface?"

"It uses a 2-way SMS platform to conduct weekly coaching visits and deliver health education, which lowers the barrier to entry for Medicaid patients who may lack consistent access to smartphones or broadband, relying instead on basic text messaging infrastructure."

nodes.title: GamerPay
nodes.description: A secure marketplace for trading gaming skins and assets with instant validation and parental consent features. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://gamerpay.gg | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/gamerpay

GamerPay operates as a marketplace for trading gaming skins and digital assets, solving the prevalent issue of scams by integrating directly with games to instantly validate all trades. The company was acquired, marking its exit from the YC Summer 2021 batch.

Founded by a team previously behind a major Danish secondhand clothing marketplace, GamerPay addresses a significant pain point: 46% of surveyed gamers have been scammed more than once, with over half being minors who are often restricted from trading for cash on social media. To address this, the company built a fully compliant system for parental consent, enabling a broader range of gamers to trade legally while providing peace of mind to parents.

Based in Copenhagen with a team of six, GamerPay targets a market of 215 million annual trades in supported games. The platform generates revenue through a per-trade fee model, aiming to capture a share of the growing blockchain game economy.

_Usage:_

"How does GamerPay handle the legal issues of minors trading digital assets, and how is that different from just using a standard payment processor?"

"GamerPay integrates directly with the games to validate trades instantly, which prevents the scams that plague other marketplaces. Crucially, it includes a fully compliant system for parental consent, which allows minors to trade legally with their parents' approval. This is a specific compliance layer that standard payment processors or generic marketplaces don't typically offer for gaming assets, especially given that a large portion of the user base is under 18."

nodes.title: Pactima
nodes.description: Live video signing for real-time agreements. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://pactima.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/pactima

Pactima provides a real-time solution that allows users to view and sign documents while simultaneously hosting a secured video call. By combining digital signatures with live video, the platform enables transactions that traditionally required in-person meetings to be conducted online. The company operates as a B2B SaaS provider focused on the legal and documents sectors.

Pactima was acquired, marking a significant milestone for the venture-backed startup. The company is based in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada, with a remote-friendly team structure.

_Usage:_

"How does Pactima differ from standard e-signature tools like DocuSign?"

"Standard e-signature tools typically handle the document transmission and signature capture asynchronously, whereas Pactima integrates a secured video call directly into the signing process. This allows parties to negotiate, verify identity, and sign in real-time, effectively replicating the experience of an in-person closing or meeting without the need for separate video conferencing software."

nodes.body:

Bytebot provides an open source container designed to simplify the development of computer use agents. It offers a ready-made environment for desktop automation, featuring specific APIs for handling mouse movements, keyboard input, and screenshot capture.

The company enables developers to build robust and dynamic agents that can be configured and run in any environment. Bytebot was acquired, marking its exit from the YC ecosystem.

nodes.title: Cloudthread
nodes.description: An analytics platform for engineering teams to attribute and track cloud cost savings. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://cloudthread.io | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/cloudthread

Cloudthread is a San Francisco-based analytics platform designed to help engineering teams build cost efficiently in the cloud. The company focuses on eliminating cloud waste by providing tools to attribute and track savings, ultimately reducing cloud bills and preventing costly re-architectures.

The platform was developed by the team behind Lyft's internal cloud cost management system, leveraging that deep expertise to serve external organizations. By engaging engineers directly, Cloudthread aims to save hours of engineering time through better cost visibility and management.

Cloudthread has since been acquired, marking its exit from the YC Summer 2021 batch.

_Usage:_

"How does Cloudthread differ from standard cloud billing dashboards?"

"Unlike standard billing dashboards that just show total spend, Cloudthread focuses on attribution and tracking specific savings. It is built on the internal system used by Lyft, so it is designed to engage engineers directly in the cost management process rather than just reporting numbers to finance, helping teams prevent expensive re-architectures by identifying waste early."

nodes.title: inai
nodes.description: inai offers a single integration for global payments, connecting merchants to various gateways, wallets, and BNPL providers. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.inai.io | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/inai

inai provides a unified integration layer that allows companies to accept digital payments globally through a single API. It connects merchants to a wide range of payment infrastructure, including gateways like Stripe, Adyen, and Braintree, as well as wallets such as PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, and buy-now-pay-later services like Klarna and Affirm.

The platform features a no-code dashboard that enables merchants to customize checkout experiences by region, displaying specific payment methods and local currency pricing for different markets. A key differentiator is that merchant data remains with inai rather than being locked into a specific payment service provider, which simplifies the process of switching between providers.

Founded in Summer 2021, the company operated with a team of 14 across London, Delaware, and remote locations before being acquired.

_Usage:_

"How does inai handle data ownership compared to using Stripe directly?"

"With inai, your data stays with inai rather than being siloed inside a specific PSP like Stripe. This architecture makes it significantly easier to switch between underlying providers, such as moving from Stripe to Adyen or Braintree, because you are not locked into a single provider's data ecosystem."

nodes.title: Keyri
nodes.description: Secure fraud prevention and authentication platform for developers. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://keyri.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/keyri

Keyri provides a secure fraud prevention and authentication platform designed to help companies keep bad actors off their platforms while delighting users. By tying user identities to trusted devices through mobile application and browser fingerprinting, the company prevents fraudulent activities such as account takeovers, bot attacks, and referral abuse. It establishes an immutable device fingerprint for every device to alert businesses of suspicious activity during sign-up, log-in, or subsequent authentication events.

The platform also includes a passwordless authentication suite that leverages Passkeys, WebAuthn, and QR codes to enable biometric authentication across all platforms and devices. This approach strengthens multi-factor account security and reduces reliance on tedious or unsecure authentication methods.

Founded in the Summer 2021 batch, Keyri was acquired, marking its exit from the YC program.

_Usage:_

"How does Keyri's device fingerprinting differ from standard IP-based fraud checks?"

"Keyri creates an immutable device fingerprint that ties a user's identity to a specific trusted device, rather than relying on mutable IP addresses. This allows it to detect suspicious devices during sign-up or log-in events, which is more effective for preventing account takeovers and bot attacks than IP-based methods alone."

nodes.description: No-code email marketing platform that embeds interactive forms and widgets directly into emails. YC S21.
nodes.body:

Mailmodo is a B2B SaaS company that provides a no-code email marketing platform designed to create app-like experiences within email clients. By allowing marketers to embed interactive elements such as forms, shopping carts, calendars, and NPS surveys directly into messages, the platform reduces the number of steps required for user engagement. This approach aims to increase email conversion rates by enabling actions like feedback collection, meeting booking, and abandoned cart recovery without leaving the inbox.

The company, which operates with a team of approximately 70 people from San Francisco and remote locations, was part of the Y Combinator Summer 2021 batch. Its focus on interactive email widgets distinguishes it from traditional static email tools by facilitating direct user interaction and lead generation within the email interface itself.

Mailmodo has since been acquired, marking a significant milestone for the company in the competitive email marketing space.

_Usage:_

"How does Mailmodo differ from standard email marketing tools like Mailchimp or HubSpot?"

"Standard tools typically send static content that requires users to click a link and navigate to a website to take action. Mailmodo allows you to embed functional widgets—like booking calendars, product carts, or feedback forms—directly inside the email body, so users can complete the entire transaction or interaction without leaving their inbox."

Vogent provides an all-in-one platform for constructing voice agents, utilizing intelligent building blocks such as IVR detection models and custom phone-ready LLMs. The platform also features drag-and-drop conversational flow builders to streamline the development process. Based in San Francisco, the company operates in the B2B sector with a focus on sales and operations.

Vogent was acquired, marking a significant milestone in its trajectory as a developer tool for voice AI infrastructure. Instead of engineering the entire stack from raw APIs, developers can assemble these intelligent building blocks to deploy agents faster, specifically targeting B2B sales and operations use cases."

nodes.title: Axle
nodes.description: AI-native clearinghouse automating property and casualty insurance workflows. YC S22.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://axle.insure | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/axle

Axle operates as an AI-native clearinghouse for the property and casualty insurance sector. The company provides infrastructure and AI agents that automate complex workflows for third parties, handling tasks such as verification, monitoring, and policy updates.

Based in New York City with a team of 20, Axle has helped Fortune 500 businesses including Rocket Mortgage, Avis, and Experian accelerate their operations. The platform claims to speed up workflows by 95% while recovering over $220M in potential losses.

Axle is backed by Gradient, Y Combinator, and the founding team of Plaid, positioning it at the intersection of fintech and advanced AI application in the insurance industry.

"How does Axle differ from traditional insurance clearinghouses?"

"Axle uses AI agents to automate specific, complex steps like verification and policy updates rather than just moving data between systems. This approach is designed to significantly reduce processing time, with the company claiming a 95% speedup for clients like Rocket Mortgage and Experian, while also identifying and recovering potential losses that might otherwise slip through."

nodes.body:
**Website:** https://kashin.app/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/kashin

Kashin provides small loans to micro-merchants and individuals operating within the informal economy across Latin America. The company serves a user base of 10,000 people and generates nearly $2 million in annualized revenue through these lending services.

To manage risk in this underserved market, Kashin employs a proprietary AI risk model for underwriting. This system processes over 250 variables derived from user smartphones and credit bureau data to make lending decisions.

The team consists of 45 people and is based in Lima, Peru, with remote operations.

"How does Kashin handle credit risk for borrowers who likely lack traditional credit histories?"

"It uses a proprietary AI risk model that analyzes more than 250 variables pulled from the user's smartphone and credit bureau data to perform underwriting, allowing it to assess creditworthiness in the informal economy where standard methods might fail."

nodes.title: Relevium Medical
nodes.description: Developing an injectable gel therapeutic for knee osteoarthritis that provides long-lasting pain relief. YC S22.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://relevium-medical.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/relevium-medical

Relevium Medical is developing a platform injectable gel-based therapeutic designed to treat knee osteoarthritis, a progressive disease affecting approximately half the population. The company aims to address the current standard of care, which often requires repeat injections and strong oral medications that can lead to opioid addiction.

The team has secured $3.7 million in non-dilutive funding and completed preclinical testing, demonstrating that the drug is safe and selectively blocks pain-transmitting nerves. Preliminary results indicate the treatment provides pain relief that lasts four times as long as existing options.

Based in Galway, Ireland, Relevium Medical targets a $7.7 billion market opportunity in the US alone. The platform biotherapeutic is also designed to be applicable to other joints affected by osteoarthritis, such as the hip and ankle.

_Usage:_

"How does this gel compare to the current standard of care for knee osteoarthritis?"

"Currently, patients often rely on repeat injections and high-dose oral medications, which can be highly addictive. Relevium's gel selectively blocks the nerves that transmit pain and has shown in preclinical testing to provide relief that lasts four times as long as those existing treatments."

nodes.title: Firecrawl
nodes.description: Firecrawl provides an API to convert web pages into clean, LLM-ready data for AI agents. YC S22.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.firecrawl.dev | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/firecrawl

Firecrawl offers an API that transforms any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data, solving the complex problem of making the web accessible to AI agents. The company positions itself as essential infrastructure for the AI ecosystem, enabling developers and other AI companies to gather data at scale.

Operating out of San Francisco with a team of just three people, Firecrawl has achieved significant traction, reportedly reaching 8 figures in ARR in its first year and doubling that figure in its second. The platform has gained substantial developer adoption, evidenced by over 150,000 GitHub stars, and is used by various AI companies to power their data gathering needs.

_Usage:_

"How does Firecrawl handle the messy HTML of the web for LLM consumption?"

"Firecrawl takes a URL and converts it into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data via a single API call. This abstracts away the difficult process of parsing and cleaning raw web content, allowing AI agents to interact with the web without dealing with the underlying HTML complexity."

nodes.title: Invofox
nodes.description: A document parsing and data extraction API for software teams. YC S22.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://invofox.com?utm_source=yc | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/invofox

Invofox provides a document parsing and data extraction API designed for software teams. It serves over 150 companies, primarily in the B2B and finance sectors, offering a solution that learns automatically from user feedback to improve accuracy over time.

The company distinguishes itself by guaranteeing over 99% accuracy through written SLAs and employing a simple pricing model based on per-page charges. Any documents where users report an error are processed for free. Invofox is a 12-person team based in Madrid, Spain, and operates remotely.

_Usage:_

"How does Invofox handle accuracy guarantees compared to standard OCR services?"

"Invofox includes a contractual SLA that guarantees over 99% accuracy. If a user reports an error on a document, that specific document is processed for free, which incentivizes the system to maintain high precision while allowing it to learn from corrections automatically."

nodes.title: Roforco
nodes.description: Building viral AI consumer apps and games on Roblox. YC S22.
nodes.body:
**YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/roforco

Roforco is a four-person game studio based in Kristiansand, Norway, that operates as one of the top studios on the Roblox platform. The team has launched seven original titles, including Korrupt Zombies and Sunsilk City, which have collectively been played by over 100 million users.

The company reached a peak of 10.2 million monthly active users, driven by a strong focus on social virality. Roforco maintains a significant social presence with over 100,000 TikTok followers and 64,000 Discord members, generating tens of millions of views across TikTok and YouTube.

Founded by two 17-year-old high school dropouts who began building viral consumer products at age 12, the studio was accepted into the Y Combinator Summer 2022 batch.

"Roforco relies heavily on organic social reach rather than paid advertising, leveraging over 100,000 TikTok followers and 64,000 Discord members to generate tens of millions of views. This social-first strategy helped their seven original titles reach over 100 million users and peak at 10.2 million monthly active users."

nodes.title: Metriport
nodes.description: Real-time healthcare data infrastructure that unifies scattered patient records into a single API. YC S22.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://metriport.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/metriport

Metriport provides real-time access to medical data for 340 million individuals across the US by connecting to all major healthcare IT systems. The open-source platform manages dozens of connections across national and state HIEs, QHINs, ADT networks, pharmacies, labs, and EHRs. It matches, extracts, standardizes, deduplicates, and enriches these records into a unified data model accessible via a single API, data warehouse, or directly within an EHR.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, the company processes 4.2 billion network requests a month and returns the first structured record in under 15 seconds. Beyond longitudinal clinical data, Metriport offers ambient monitoring to alert providers in real time during patient transitions of care. It also delivers AI-driven insights, including medical record summarization, condition suspecting, and surfacing care gaps.

The platform supports teams across care delivery, value-based programs, and health tech platforms, with users including Amazon One Medical, Strive Health, Color, Sollis Health, and Canvas Medical.

_Usage:_

"How does Metriport handle the fragmentation of patient data across different EHRs and HIEs?"

"It acts as a middleware layer that connects to dozens of sources, including national HIEs, QHINs, and direct EHR integrations. Instead of requiring you to build separate connectors for each system, it ingests the raw data, deduplicates it, and standardizes it into a single unified data model. You then access this clean, structured data through a single API or data warehouse, which also includes AI features like record summarization and care gap detection."

nodes.title: AnythingLLM

nodes.body:
**Website:** https://anythingllm.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/anythingllm

AnythingLLM is an all-in-one AI application designed to make local AI practical for everyday users. It operates across desktop and mobile platforms, allowing individuals to run AI models on their own devices rather than relying solely on cloud services.

The project is notable for its open-source nature, having accumulated 56K stars on GitHub. By prioritizing on-device processing, it targets the consumer market with a tool that prioritizes local utility and accessibility.

"AnythingLLM runs locally on your device, meaning it processes data on your hardware rather than sending it to external servers. This makes it an open-source, all-in-one solution for desktop and mobile users who want a practical, local AI experience without the dependency on cloud infrastructure."

nodes.title: Typewise
nodes.description: An AI-first customer service platform that orchestrates agents to resolve requests end-to-end by taking real actions across your stack. YC S22.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://typewise.app | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/typewise

Typewise is an AI-first customer service platform designed to boost productivity by allowing orchestrated agents to resolve requests end-to-end. Instead of relying on flowcharts or code, teams describe desired outcomes in natural language, which the platform compiles into working automations. This approach enables users to safely simulate changes and roll them out step by step.

The company is notable for its ability to cut support effort by over 50% while increasing CSAT and NPS for Fortune 500 brands such as Unilever and DPD. With more than 200 integrations, Typewise reads from and writes to CRM, ERP, and other systems to fully resolve cases, handing off to humans only where they add the most value. Hybrid intelligence features allow for partial hand-offs, review-before-send, and context-preserving resumption.

Based in Zürich, Switzerland, with a team of 12, Typewise operates natively within its own ticketing system or integrates with existing tools like Zendesk, Salesforce, and Freshdesk. The platform includes a company-specific AI language model to keep interactions on-brand and is EU-hosted and ISO 27001 certified.

_Usage:_

"How does Typewise handle the transition between AI automation and human support?"

"Typewise uses hybrid intelligence to manage this transition, allowing for partial hand-offs and review-before-send workflows. It can resume context-preserving interactions so that human agents stay in control, ensuring that cases are only escalated to humans when they add the most value rather than for every single ticket."

nodes.title: Gullak Money
nodes.description: Gullak automates micro-savings by investing small daily amounts into digital gold. YC S22.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://gullak.money | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/gullak-money

Gullak is a mobile fintech application based in Bengaluru that automates the savings process by converting small, regular contributions into digital gold. The company addresses a significant gap in the Indian market where hundreds of millions of individuals save in bank deposits that fail to outpace inflation, despite gold being a culturally significant asset with higher returns. By leveraging UPI Autopay infrastructure, Gullak enables users to save as little as $1 per day, removing the friction and high minimum ticket sizes associated with traditional offline gold purchases.

Since launching in India, the company has grown to 40,000 transacting users with a monthly gross transaction value of $280K, reporting 25% week-on-week growth. The founding team previously built the BHIM UPI App and large-scale payment systems for major partners, processing over 30 million payments daily. Gullak targets a $1.5Bn market opportunity by combining automated micro-savings with gold-backed lending for the middle-income demographic.

_Usage:_

"How does Gullak handle the technical complexity of automating small, recurring payments for gold investment compared to traditional methods?"

"Gullak utilizes UPI Autopay infrastructure to automate the transfer of small daily amounts, such as $1, directly into digital gold. This approach eliminates the need for users to manually accumulate funds or visit physical stores, which previously required a minimum purchase of $50 and incurred storage charges. The automation relies on payment rails that were not widely available for this specific use case until recently, allowing for frictionless, high-frequency micro-investments."

nodes.title: CODEXA
nodes.description: AI agent that automates the entire international trade operation, including customs, payments, and trade finance. YC S22.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://codexa.com.br/desembaraco-aduaneiro | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/codexa

Codexa is an AI agent that manages the full scope of international trade operations for exporters and importers. It handles customs processes with government agencies and regulators, orchestrates cross-border payments, and provides credit solutions for trade finance to move goods and money seamlessly across borders.

Built by a Central Bank–licensed FX bank, the platform is designed to eliminate regulatory friction and reduce costs in global commerce. The company is based in Manaus, Brazil, and maintains a team of 40 people.

The system currently powers over USD 2 billion in annual volume across more than 17,000 transactions, demonstrating significant scale in the fintech and payments sectors.

_Usage:_

"How does Codexa handle the regulatory side of international trade compared to manual processes?"

"Instead of manually navigating different government agencies and regulators for each shipment, Codexa’s AI agent directly handles the customs processes. It automates the interaction with these entities while simultaneously orchestrating the cross-border payments and providing necessary trade finance credit, effectively removing the manual regulatory friction from the workflow."

nodes.title: Chariot
nodes.description: Building the financial infrastructure and payment network for the $326 billion donor-advised fund market. YC S22.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://givechariot.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/chariot-2

Chariot provides end-to-end financial infrastructure for the donor-advised fund (DAF) market, which represents $326 billion in assets and is the fastest-growing segment of philanthropy. The platform simplifies the process for grantmakers to send payments and for nonprofits to receive, reconcile, and enrich their donation data.

The company powers DAFpay, described as the industry’s first integrated DAF payment option and a TIME’s Best Invention of 2025. This payment method is embedded on over 100,000 donation forms from organizations such as the American Cancer Society, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, and the University of Pennsylvania, as well as on major fundraising platforms like GoFundMe and GiveButter.

Based in New York City with a team of 24, Chariot is an active YC Summer 2022 company that has already processed hundreds of millions of dollars through its network.

_Usage:_

"How does Chariot's DAFpay differ from standard credit card processing for nonprofits?"

"DAFpay is an integrated payment option specifically for donor-advised funds, allowing donors to give directly from their DAF accounts rather than using personal credit cards. It is embedded on over 100,000 donation forms and major platforms like GoFundMe, serving as a primary payment method that simplifies reconciliation for nonprofits compared to traditional gift processing."

nodes.title: Shipamax
nodes.description: Shipamax provides end-to-end automation that extracts machine‑readable data from any logistics document. YC W17.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://shipamax.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/shipamax

Shipamax builds automation software that can “understand” any logistics document and turn it into a business‑ready, machine‑readable format. Its core technology uses natural‑language processing to extract structured data from the myriad forms, invoices, and shipping manifests that move through supply chains.

By converting these documents automatically, the platform removes the manual work that traditionally ties together up to twenty companies in a single shipment, making the behind‑the‑scenes logistics process simpler and more scalable. Customers in the B2B supply‑chain and logistics space value the ability to streamline operations and adapt to today’s on‑demand economy.

Shipamax was acquired after demonstrating this capability, and it now operates from London with a team of 32 engineers and product specialists.

nodes.title: Vena Medical
nodes.description: Vena Medical provides physicians with the world’s smallest camera for neurovascular procedures. YC W18.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.venamed.ca/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/vena-medical

Vena Medical has developed a miniature camera designed for physicians to use during neurovascular procedures, positioning it as the world’s smallest of its kind. The technology’s pre‑clinical results were published in the Journal of Neuro‑Interventional Surgery and presented at the World Live Neurovascular Conference, underscoring its clinical relevance.

The company was named a top‑3 finalist for Innovator of the Year by the Congress of Neurological Surgeons and has raised a Series A round to fund commercialization, including FDA clearance, Health Canada approval, ISO 13485 certification, first‑in‑human trials, and early revenue. Vena Medical operates out of Kitchener, ON with a team of seven.

_Usage:_

"How does Vena Medical’s camera differ from the larger imaging tools typically used in neurovascular surgery?"

"Vena’s camera is marketed as the world’s smallest, allowing it to be inserted directly into vessels where larger scopes cannot reach, which can provide higher‑resolution images from inside the vasculature. The company’s pre‑clinical data, published in a peer‑reviewed journal, and its regulatory clearances support its claim of delivering minimally invasive imaging that standard larger devices cannot achieve."

nodes.body:

Observe.AI is a leader in Contact Center AI that helps top brands analyze 100% of their calls and streamline quality‑assurance workflows. The platform transcribes every call with high accuracy, applies automatic speech recognition and natural language processing, and provides agent assistance and coaching tools, giving businesses full visibility into their customer‑service operations.

The company serves more than 150 customers and partners, including Root Insurance, Alcon Laboratories, TripAdvisor, and Pearson. nodes.description: Jido Maps turns raw visual data into deployed computer‑vision models for businesses. YC W18.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://jidomaps.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/jido-maps

Jido Maps provides a platform that lets teams with little machine‑learning expertise convert visual or scanned data into production‑ready computer‑vision models. It offers a rapid proof‑of‑concept workflow that can be delivered in under a week. The service is used for security‑camera monitoring, automated data entry, interpreting web‑scraped images, validated user photo inputs, augmented reality, and mobile product scanning, positioning it as an infrastructure layer for B2B customers. Jido Maps was acquired and operates from San Francisco with a remote team of six engineers.

_Usage:_

"How is Jido Maps different from building my own computer‑vision model with open‑source tools?"

"Jido Maps handles the entire pipeline—data ingestion, model training, and deployment—so you can get a working model in under a week without needing machine‑learning expertise, whereas using open‑source libraries requires you to assemble and manage each step yourself."

nodes.title: Medumo
nodes.description: Medumo automates patient navigation with timed text and email guidance for hospitals and clinics. YC W18.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.medumo.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/medumo

Medumo, founded by a team of Harvard and Yale‑trained physicians, engineers, designers, and social entrepreneurs, offers CareTours™ – a platform that sends automated, precisely‑timed text and email messages to guide patients through medical procedures. The service provides turn‑by‑turn instructions without disrupting clinical workflow, helping hospitals, ASCs, and practices across all specialties.

By delivering these messages, Medumo dramatically improves procedural completion rates, increases referral conversion, reduces staff burden, and recovers revenue loss for its healthcare customers. The company is based in Boston, employs 12 people, and operates in the Healthcare and Healthcare IT sectors.

Medumo was acquired, as noted in its YC directory entry, underscoring the market’s interest in automated patient navigation solutions.

_Usage:_

"How is Medumo’s CareTours different from a typical appointment reminder service?"

"CareTours goes beyond simple reminders by providing a sequence of timed, context‑specific messages that walk patients through each step of a procedure, rather than just notifying them of an upcoming appointment. This turn‑by‑turn guidance is designed to improve completion rates and reduce staff workload, which standard reminder tools don’t address."

nodes.title: SharpestMinds
nodes.description: SharpestMinds runs peer-to-peer data-science mentorships funded by income-share agreements. YC W18.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://sharpestminds.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/sharpestminds

SharpestMinds operates a mentorship program for aspiring data scientists that pairs them with experienced engineers. The mentors, drawn from leading AI groups at Apple, Uber, Tesla, Facebook and Amazon, guide mentees through real-world projects and interview preparation. Mentees join the program at no upfront cost and agree to pay a percentage of their first-year salary after they are hired, aligning the program's revenue with the success of its graduates. The model functions as a talent-matching service that blends education with recruiting. SharpestMinds was acquired after its Winter 2018 Y Combinator batch. The company, based in Toronto with remote staff and a four-person team, operates in the B2B recruiting and talent space.

_Usage:_

"Is SharpestMinds' income-share agreement similar to a traditional coding bootcamp's tuition model?"

"No, SharpestMinds only charges a share of the graduate's first-year salary after they secure a job, whereas bootcamps typically require upfront tuition regardless of outcome. The mentorship is delivered by engineers from top AI groups, and payment is contingent on employment, aligning incentives."

The service leverages artificial intelligence and fintech techniques to generate rental‑specific credit data, bridging a gap between traditional credit reporting and the needs of landlords and renters. Naborly operates out of Toronto with a team of about 25 employees.

"Naborly bases its scores on rent‑payment behavior rather than the broader credit history used by traditional bureaus, so tenants can build credit simply by paying rent on time, which is a data point most conventional credit reports don’t consider."

Glimpse K12 captures everything a district does to impact student outcomes and evaluates those activities in the context of student achievement. nodes.title: Prometheus
nodes.description: Prometheus turns captured CO₂ and water into zero‑net‑carbon gasoline, diesel and jet fuel using solar and wind electricity. YC W19.
nodes.body:
**Website:** http://www.prometheusfuels.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/prometheus

Prometheus removes CO₂ and water from the air and uses electricity generated by solar and wind farms to synthesize electrofuels that are chemically identical to gasoline, diesel and jet fuel. The fuels can be used in existing vehicles and aircraft without any engine modifications, and they do not add new CO₂ to the atmosphere because the carbon is drawn from the air. Each gallon of Prometheus electrofuel effectively leaves a gallon of fossil oil un‑burned. Prometheus’ zero‑net‑carbon jet fuel is priced at one cent per gallon less than conventional jet fuel, making it the first renewable fuel that can compete on price. American Airlines has placed an order for 10 million gallons, which the company plans to begin shipping next year.

_Usage:_

"Why can Prometheus’ electrofuel be cheaper than traditional jet fuel despite the energy needed for CO₂ capture and synthesis?"

"Prometheus uses only solar and wind electricity, which have very low marginal costs, to power the electro‑chemical process that converts captured CO₂ and water into fuel. By avoiding the cost of extracting and refining fossil oil, the overall production cost can be lower, allowing the company to price its jet fuel a cent per gallon below conventional alternatives."

nodes.title: Cosmic
nodes.description: Cosmic provides an AI‑powered headless CMS for fast‑moving teams. YC W19.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.cosmicjs.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/cosmic

Cosmic offers a headless content management system that combines a flexible content infrastructure with AI agents that live in Slack, write content, build features, fix bugs, and deploy apps autonomously. Developers can access a REST API with sub‑100 ms response times, a TypeScript SDK, CLI, and an MCP Server that plugs directly into Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot, while content teams use an intuitive dashboard with 20+ metafield types, AI image and video generation, and never‑ever migrations.

The platform is used by teams in more than 150 countries, handling over 50 million API requests per month and offering a 99.9 % uptime SLA. Cosmic’s forever‑free plan requires no credit card, making it easy for teams to adopt without building or maintaining their own CMS infrastructure.

_Usage:_

"Can Cosmic's AI agents automatically deploy code changes, or do I still need to run my own CI/CD pipeline?"

"Cosmic’s AI agents can fix bugs, build features, and deploy apps autonomously through its MCP Server integration with tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot, so many routine deployments can be handled without a separate pipeline, though you still have full access to the REST API and can manage deployments manually if desired."

nodes.title: Glide
nodes.description: Glide turns spreadsheets into beautiful, intelligent apps. YC W19.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.glideapps.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/glide

Glide is a web-based app builder that lets non-programmers quickly create internal business applications. Users can start from scratch, from a prompt, or by importing a spreadsheet, and the platform handles UI design, collaboration, and deployment.

The company positions itself as bringing app development out of the Dark Ages, making it web-based, collaborative, accessible, and fun after decades of little change. With the rise of AI-assisted coding, Glide's latest generation offers an AI-first method that removes the need to manage granular control, security, authentication, database infrastructure, or deployment concerns.

Glide's mission is to become the operating system for businesses by turning operational spreadsheets and data into beautiful, intelligent apps. The team of three technical founders, formerly early employees at Xamarin, has grown to 46 people across San Francisco and remote locations.

_Usage:_

"How is Glide's AI-first app builder different from other no-code platforms?"

"Glide lets users generate full-featured internal apps directly from a spreadsheet or a natural-language prompt, and the AI handles UI layout, data handling, security, and deployment, so users don’t have to manually configure those parts as they would on typical no-code tools."

nodes.body:

Based in Singapore, it uses cellular agriculture to grow shrimp and other marine protein in a laboratory from animal cells, eliminating the need for animal farming. Shiok Meats is the first cell‑based meat company in Singapore and Southeast Asia, positioning it as a regional pioneer in cultivated seafood. "Shiok Meats says its lab‑grown shrimp matches the taste, texture and nutrient profile of conventional shrimp, while being animal‑free and reducing environmental impact."

nodes.title: Atomic Alchemy
nodes.description: Atomic Alchemy builds privately-owned nuclear reactors to produce medical radioisotopes. YC W19.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://atomicalchemy.us | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/atomic-alchemy

Atomic Alchemy is constructing a bank of small modular reactors that will serve as a dedicated, scalable facility for producing radioisotopes used in nuclear medicine, such as the Molybdenum‑99 needed for diagnostics and cancer treatments. The current global supply of Molybdenum‑99 relies on six aging, government‑run research reactors abroad, five of which are 45‑65 years old, creating a fragile and lengthy supply chain.

By creating the world’s first privately‑owned reactors focused on isotope production, Atomic Alchemy aims to shorten lead times and enable more reliable access to materials for clinical trials and treatments. The company, based in Idaho Falls, ID with a team of eight, was acquired, reflecting the strategic value of its hard‑tech approach to medical device supply.

_Usage:_

"How does Atomic Alchemy’s private reactor model solve the supply‑chain problems of Molybdenum‑99 compared to the existing government‑run reactors?"

"Atomic Alchemy plans to operate its own small modular reactors solely for radioisotope production, eliminating dependence on the six foreign, aging research reactors that currently supply 80% of Molybdenum‑99. By owning the production facility, it can scale output, reduce transport delays, and provide a more stable source for diagnostics and cancer therapies."

Windsor operated with a five‑person team based in San Francisco and remote locations. "It leverages AI and deepfake technology to synthesize the speaker’s appearance and voice while inserting personalized details such as the recipient’s name, company, and location, producing videos that look and sound like a bespoke recording."

nodes.title: Impactive (formerly Outvote)
nodes.description: Provides a distributed organizing and peer-to-peer texting platform for progressive political campaigns and advocacy causes. YC S18.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.impactive.io/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/impactive

Impactive, originally founded in 2017 as Outvote with support from Y Combinator and Higher Ground Labs, developed a distributed organizing platform for political and civic campaigns. Initially created as a get-out-the-vote tool for Democrats, the product grew into a full-service suite that allows progressive causes, campaigns, and nonprofits to engage supporters directly.

The platform demonstrated significant scale during major election cycles. In the 2018 midterms, volunteers contacted over 1 million voters through the platform, and by 2020, volunteers had sent over 100 million text messages. Impactive served over 500 clients nationwide, including Planned Parenthood, the DCCC, SEIU, Community Change, When We All Vote, and Greenpeace.

Operating with a remote team based out of Boston, Impactive has since been acquired.

_Usage:_

"What scale of supporter outreach can campaigns execute using Impactive?"

"Impactive is designed for high-volume peer-to-peer mobilization, having supported over 500 clients where volunteers sent more than 100 million text messages and reached over 1 million voters during peak election cycles."

nodes.title: TransAstra Corporation
nodes.description: TransAstra develops orbital logistics solutions, including a sunlight-powered propulsion system and asteroid-detecting telescope. YC S21.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.transastra.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/transastra-corporation

TransAstra is a Los Angeles‑based company that has issued five patents and has more than a dozen pending, generating over $5 million in revenue.
Its flagship Omnivore propulsion system powers spacecraft such as the Worker Bee commercial OTV using concentrated sunlight, making it faster, cheaper, and more practical than electric propulsion while being safer and more operationally flexible than legacy chemical systems.
The Sutter Telescope System locates resource‑rich asteroids and orbital debris that existing technologies cannot find, and it can identify dark, fast‑moving objects between Earth and the Moon—an issue that national defense and the Space Force consider critical. Ground‑based observatories already use Sutter, and the company will begin commercial sales of Sutter SDA data next month after tracking dozens of faint moving objects. Once launched, the telescope will be 300,000 times more cost‑effective than any other known design, revolutionizing sense‑making in space.

_Usage:_

"How does the Omnivore propulsion system compare to traditional electric or chemical propulsion?"

"Omnivore uses concentrated sunlight to propel spacecraft, making it faster and cheaper than electric propulsion and substantially safer and more operationally flexible than legacy chemical systems."

"It uses AI to analyze medical records and check if the stated diagnosis is actually supported by the clinical evidence present in those records, effectively automating the verification process to catch errors or unsupported claims."

nodes.title: Pulppo

nodes.title: Decoda Health
nodes.description: An all-in-one EMR and practice management platform for med spas and elective care with integrated AI workflows. YC S23.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://decodahealth.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/decoda-health

Decoda Health provides a unified electronic medical record and practice management system designed specifically for med spas, wellness clinics, and aesthetics practices. The platform consolidates fragmented tools for scheduling, charting, payments, and patient communication into a single interface, addressing the inefficiencies and errors associated with managing multiple disconnected systems.

The company embeds artificial intelligence throughout its core workflows, including an AI front desk that handles calls and bookings around the clock, an ambient scribe for real-time clinical note generation, and automated patient follow-ups to maintain calendar utilization. Decoda is based in Toronto, Canada, and supports a team of 15 people.

The platform is currently live in over 150 clinics and processes more than $100 million in annual transactions, serving as a comprehensive operational hub for elective care providers.

_Usage:_

"How does Decoda handle the administrative burden that usually requires separate software for scheduling and billing?"

"Decoda replaces the typical stack of five to ten disconnected tools by integrating scheduling, payments, memberships, inventory, and analytics into one platform. It also automates key administrative tasks using AI, such as answering phone calls and booking patients 24/7, which reduces the need for manual front-desk management and helps keep the clinic's calendar full."

nodes.title: Cardinal Gray
nodes.description: Automates DMV lien filings for auto lenders using LLMs. YC S23.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.cardinalgray.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/cardinal-gray

Cardinal Gray helps auto lenders automate the process of filing liens with Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) offices. The company addresses the complexity of this task, which varies significantly by state and county, by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to handle the interactions.

Based in New York City, the six-person team focuses on enterprise software for the credit and lending industry. It has processed lien filings for over $1 billion in loans, streamlining a traditionally manual and fragmented administrative burden for financial institutions.

_Usage:_

"Why use an LLM for DMV filings instead of just hardcoding the rules for each state?"

"The filing process varies by state and county, making a static rule-based system difficult to maintain and scale. By using LLMs, Cardinal Gray can handle the nuances and variations in DMV requirements more flexibly, allowing lenders to automate lien filings across different jurisdictions without needing to manually update code for every local change."

"Unlike traditional static analysis that only flags issues, Corgea not only identifies vulnerabilities but also generates validated fixes that developers can apply directly, resulting in higher true positive rates and lower false positives as seen by customers like Zapier and Yageo."

nodes.title: MICSI
nodes.description: AI software that doubles MRI resolution and halves scan time. YC S23.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.micsi.co/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/micsi

MICSI is a New York City-based startup developing AI software designed to enhance magnetic resonance imaging capabilities. The technology aims to double the resolution of MRI scans while simultaneously reducing scan times by half. This improvement allows imaging centers to increase their capacity and patient throughput, with the company estimating an additional $2 million in revenue per MRI scanner.

Beyond immediate efficiency gains, MICSI views its initial offering as a step toward transforming MRI into a quantitative instrument. The goal is to provide highly reproducible data that supports more accurate diagnoses and patient management. The company operates with a small team of two and focuses on the healthcare and diagnostics sectors.

_Usage:_

"How does MICSI actually achieve faster scans without losing image quality, and is the $2 million revenue claim realistic?"

"The system uses AI to double resolution while cutting scan time in half, which directly increases the number of patients an imaging center can process per day. The $2 million figure is a projected revenue gain per scanner based on this increased throughput, not a direct fee for the software itself. It’s a capacity play for facilities looking to maximize existing hardware utilization."

nodes.title: PeerDB
nodes.description: Fast, native ETL tool for streaming data from Postgres to warehouses and storage engines. YC S23.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://peerdb.io/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/peerdb

PeerDB provides a fast and cost-effective method for streaming data from Postgres to data warehouses, queues, and storage engines. It supports multiple streaming modes, including log-based CDC, cursor-based, and XMIN-based approaches, while handling native Postgres features like jsonb, arrays, and postgis. The company claims its solution is 10x faster than existing tools and efficiently manages schema changes and toast columns.

PeerDB was acquired, marking a notable exit for this developer-focused data engineering tool. The company operates with a small team of two, focusing on open-source solutions for B2B analytics and enterprise software.

_Usage:_

"How does PeerDB handle complex Postgres data types compared to standard ETL tools?"

"PeerDB is designed to natively support comprehensive Postgres data types, including jsonb, arrays, and postgis, while efficiently streaming toast columns and handling schema changes. It offers log-based, cursor-based, and XMIN-based streaming modes, claiming to be 10x faster than existing alternatives for moving data at scale from Postgres to targets like data warehouses and storage engines."

nodes.title: Mito Health
nodes.description: At-cost lab testing marketplace that profits when you test less. YC S24.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://mitohealth.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mito-health

Mito Health is a San Francisco-based startup that operates an at-cost lab testing marketplace designed to incentivize users to make better health decisions rather than simply buying more tests. The platform uses a 60-second quiz to provide personalized recommendations on which tests to take, which to skip, and the exact cost, ensuring members pay the published lab price while non-members pay a 10% premium.

The service includes clinician-reviewed next steps, longitudinal tracking, and an AI Concierge that helps build personalized test panels. Mito Health positions its business model as a counterpoint to traditional health companies that profit from increased test volume, instead deriving value from helping users avoid unnecessary spending. The company is active in the Summer 2024 YC batch with a team of five.

_Usage:_

"How does Mito Health's pricing model differ from standard direct-to-consumer lab testing services?"

"Unlike most health companies that profit when you buy more tests, Mito Health profits when you make better decisions, often meaning fewer tests. It offers every lab test at its published cost, where members pay exactly that amount and non-members pay a 10% premium. The platform uses a quiz and an AI Concierge to recommend what to test and what to skip, aiming to reduce unnecessary spending rather than drive volume."

nodes.title: Wordware
nodes.description: Building reliable AI agents that earn autonomy over time. YC S24.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://wordware.ai/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/wordware

Wordware is a San Francisco-based startup developing AI agents designed to be trusted by users. The company’s product, known as Sauna, operates as a digital coworker that learns an individual's workflows and gradually earns autonomy task by task. This approach allows the agent to handle hours of work independently while the user retains final review and decision-making power.

The team, which includes approximately 15 to 20 members, secured a $30 million seed round backed by Spark Capital, Felicis, and Y Combinator. This funding round is noted as the largest in Y Combinator history. The company is currently active and focused on building infrastructure for dependable AI collaboration.

_Usage:_

"How does Wordware's agent differ from other AI tools that try to act as immediate coworkers?"

"Most AI products attempt to function as a fully capable coworker from the start, relying on user trust. Wordware's agent, Sauna, takes a different approach by starting with limited access and learning the user's specific work patterns. It earns more autonomy incrementally as it proves its reliability on individual tasks, ensuring the user always maintains the final say rather than handing over control blindly on day one."

nodes.title: Spaceium Inc
nodes.description: Spaceium builds fully automated space stations to refuel and repair spacecraft. YC S24.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://spaceium.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/spaceium-inc

Spaceium builds fully automated space stations to refuel and repair spacecraft. It has secured $86.1 million in binding commercial contracts, $230 million in the pipeline, and $1B in letters of intent, and has successfully tested hardware that will launch next year. The stations store and transfer both cryogenic and non-cryogenic fuels with zero loss, using a proprietary modular robotic arm that can transfer fuel to any spacecraft design. Customers include launch vehicles, orbital transfer vehicles, moon landers, and other spacecraft that benefit from increased payload capacity and extended travel capabilities. Spaceium's long-term vision is to build service hubs along the space superhighway connecting Earth to Moon and Mars, helping humanity become multi-planetary. The company is based in Ottawa, Canada, and operates in the industrial, aviation, and space sectors.

_Usage:_

"How does Spaceium's modular robotic arm enable fuel transfer to any spacecraft design?"

"Spaceium's proprietary modular robotic arm is designed to interface with a variety of spacecraft, allowing it to transfer both cryogenic and non-cryogenic fuels with zero loss during storage and transfer."

nodes.title: Poka Labs
nodes.description: An AI platform that helps industrial manufacturers price and quote deals faster. YC S24.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.pokalabs.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/poka-labs

Poka Labs is a San Francisco-based startup building an AI platform designed to assist sales representatives at chemical manufacturers. The system analyzes product catalogs, customer purchase behaviors, and internal tribal knowledge to generate accurate pricing and quotes, enabling teams to respond to customer requests more efficiently.

The company serves industrial manufacturers ranging from those with a few million dollars in annual sales to those with billions. By automating the complex process of quoting and pricing, Poka Labs aims to help these companies win more business while maintaining optimal margins.

Founded by Malay and Andrew, who met at Harvard Business School, the five-person team operates out of San Francisco and focuses on the intersection of B2B sales and supply chain logistics.

_Usage:_

"How does the system handle the specific pricing logic for different chemical products?"

"The platform ingests the company's specific product catalog, historical customer purchase behaviors, and unstructured 'tribal knowledge' to understand the nuances of each deal. This allows the AI to generate quotes that are not just fast, but also strategically priced to win the business, rather than relying on generic rule-based systems."

nodes.title: Lilac Labs
nodes.description: Automates drive-thru order taking for quick service restaurants using voice AI. YC S24.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.drive-thru.ai/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/lilac-labs

Lilac Labs builds a voice AI system designed to replace the human employee taking orders at drive-thrus, targeting quick service restaurants facing labor shortages and rising wages. The company notes that previous attempts at this technology were too costly and lacked the necessary accuracy and latency, but current capabilities now allow for a voice interface that meets high customer experience standards.

The startup operates in San Francisco with a team of four and was part of the Summer 2024 YC batch. It targets a massive market, citing 200,000 drive-thrus in the United States that handle 6 billion visits annually. Lilac claims its solution delivers approximately $100,000 in value per location through labor savings, upsell revenue, and reduced training costs.

The company is currently marked as Inactive in the YC directory, indicating it has since shut down.

_Usage:_

"How does this differ from the older voice ordering systems that didn't work out?"

"Previous drive-thru voice ordering attempts were expensive to implement and failed to meet the accuracy and latency thresholds required for a good customer experience. Lilac Labs argues that current AI capabilities have finally crossed that threshold, allowing for a reliable voice interface that can handle the volume and speed of a typical drive-thru without the high implementation costs of earlier solutions."

nodes.title: Serafis
nodes.description: Serafis mines unstructured data to identify narrative inflections in financial markets before they become consensus. YC S25.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://serafis.ai | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/serafis

Serafis is a San Francisco-based startup building what it calls super-intelligence for financial markets. The company uses artificial intelligence to analyze petabytes of unstructured data, aiming to detect shifts in market narratives before they reach broad consensus. Its approach is modeled on the early conviction seen in major assets like Bitcoin, Tesla, and Nvidia during their respective breakout periods.

The platform is already live with 12 organizations that manage over $70 billion in capital. By focusing on narrative intelligence, Serafis seeks to provide investors with an edge in identifying emerging trends within the financial sector.

_Usage:_

"How does Serafis differentiate itself from standard financial data providers that also track market sentiment?"

"Serafis focuses specifically on identifying narrative inflections before they become consensus, rather than just reporting on existing sentiment. It mines petabytes of unstructured data to spot early shifts in how the market views specific assets or sectors, aiming to generate conviction similar to early positions in Bitcoin or Tesla."

**Website:** https://www.ambral.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/ambral

Ambral is an AI platform designed for account management and customer success, synthesizing signals from all customer activity and interactions to build dynamic models of every account. The system identifies which customers require attention and why, then autonomously executes the best next action to drive expansions, prevent churn, and ensure no customer slips through the cracks.

The company has already been used to drive hundreds of millions of dollars in attributable expansion revenue at multi-billion dollar enterprises and top scale-ups. Based in New York City, Ambral is a four-person team that emerged from Y Combinator’s Summer 2025 batch.

_Usage:_

"How does Ambral differ from a standard CRM that just logs activity?"

"While a CRM typically requires manual input and passive tracking, Ambral actively synthesizes all customer signals into AI models and autonomously takes the next best action. It doesn't just tell you who needs attention; it executes the steps to drive expansion or prevent churn, effectively acting as an autonomous agent for customer success rather than just a database."

nodes.title: Dawn Industries
nodes.description: Automatic diagnosis and fix for industrial automation cells. YC S26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.dawnxr.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/dawn-industries

Dawn Industries develops VIM, a system that connects to entire industrial automation cells including PLCs, robots, CNC machines, and sensors. When a fault occurs, the platform identifies the cause and stages the fix, allowing operators to approve the solution with a single click. It also monitors part drift, detecting deviations seconds after a cut and recommending immediate corrections within the machine.

The company is notable for significantly reducing recovery times in large factories, dropping them from approximately 30 minutes to under two minutes. This efficiency gain saves more than $15,000 per fault. Dawn Industries is a two-person team based in San Francisco, operating in the Industrials, Manufacturing, and Robotics sectors.

_Usage:_

"How does VIM handle faults compared to traditional manual troubleshooting?"

"VIM connects directly to the cell's PLCs, robots, and sensors to automatically find the root cause of a fault and stage the fix. Instead of an operator spending 30 minutes diagnosing the issue, they simply review the proposed solution and approve it with one click, reducing recovery time to under two minutes."

nodes.title: Grocalo
nodes.description: An AI system that personalizes and distributes content for creators by analyzing audience taste and platform data. YC S26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://grocalo.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/grocalo

Grocalo operates as an AI brain designed to manage content workflows for creators. It utilizes video understanding and deep platform analytics to identify specific audience preferences, allowing it to personalize and distribute content tailored to each creator's unique followers.

The company reports generating 2 billion views and gaining 4 million followers for its clients within a two-month period. Its user base includes high-profile figures such as Jimmy O. Yang, King Bach, and Leenda Dong, who collectively possess tens of millions of followers across various platforms.

Based in Los Angeles, Grocalo focuses on the creator economy by developing an AI model capable of replicating viral success for specific audiences through data-driven personalization.

"How does Grocalo determine what content to push to a specific creator's audience?"

"It uses video understanding and deep platform analytics to model the specific 'taste' of a creator's audience. Rather than using a generic recommendation engine, it personalizes distribution based on these learned preferences to replicate virality for that specific user base."

nodes.title: Radley
nodes.description: Radley is the first AI-native radiology practice, rebuilding clinical and operational workflows from the ground up. YC S26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://radley.health/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/radley

Radley operates as the first AI-native radiology practice, having acquired an existing radiology business to reach $4.3M in annualized revenue. The company is rebuilding this practice using AI agents to address a critical shortage of radiologists, a gap that currently leaves one in six medical scans uninterpreted and is projected to worsen to one in three within a decade.

Unlike point solutions that only address software needs, Radley owns the full clinical and operational stack to overcome outdated systems and inefficient operations. The company has secured $2.2M in contracts, demonstrating market demand for its end-to-end approach to modernizing radiology workflows.

Founded by operators with experience scaling Carbon Health to over 100 clinics, Radley is based in San Francisco and operates remotely. It is part of the Y Combinator Summer 2026 batch.

_Usage:_

"How does Radley differ from standard AI diagnostic tools that just help radiologists read scans?"

"Standard tools are point solutions that only assist with interpretation, but Radley argues that the bottleneck is actually outdated systems and slow operations. Instead of just selling software, Radley acquired a practice and rebuilt the entire clinical and operational stack with agents, effectively running the radiology business itself rather than just providing a tool for existing practices to use."

nodes.title: Lyon
nodes.description: Lyon builds private foundation models on enterprise transaction data. YC S26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://lyon.so | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/lyon

Lyon builds private foundation models for banks, insurance companies, and fintechs, learning from proprietary transactions, payments, clicks, and customer interactions to predict credit, fraud, collections, income, churn, and lifetime value. The models run inside the company’s cloud, so data and intelligence remain under the customer’s control.

Lyon is already working with a major insurer and trained a model on 28 billion transactions for a fintech serving tens of millions of active users, identifying premium‑card converters four times more precisely than its existing rules. The model is now being deployed for credit.

The company is based in San Francisco, CA, and has a team of two.

_Usage:_

"How does Lyon keep data private while training foundation models?"

"Lyon trains its models inside the customer’s own cloud, ensuring that all transaction data stays within the company’s environment and is never exposed externally."

nodes.title: IMPACT Drones
nodes.description: Autonomous interceptor drones that ram hostile targets to protect critical civilian infrastructure. YC S26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://www.impact-drones.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/impact-drones

IMPACT Drones develops autonomous interceptor drones designed to defend critical civilian infrastructure, including data centers, power grids, airports, and military bases. The system operates without on-site crew; interceptors are stored in sealed containers at the protected site and launch automatically when sensors detect a hostile drone. The drones use onboard vision for guidance, allowing them to function effectively even when GPS signals are jammed.

The company positions its solution as a cost-effective alternative to legacy air defense systems, which can cost over $1 million per shot against threats that cost only $30,000. IMPACT’s interceptors are designed to cost less than the threat they neutralize and scale with swarm tactics, similar to systems currently downing Shahed drones in Ukraine. By offering a subscription model that includes hardware, reloads, and monitoring, the company provides Air Defense as a Service rather than requiring sites to purchase expensive missile systems.

Based in San Francisco, the company has secured over $180 million in signed letters of intent. It is a two-person team operating in the defense and industrials sectors, focusing on autonomous hardware and swarm robotics.

_Usage:_

"How does the cost structure of IMPACT's interceptors compare to traditional missile defense systems?"

"Legacy air defense effectors often cost over $1 million per shot, which is economically unviable when defending against cheaper threats like $30,000 drones. IMPACT’s interceptors are designed to cost less than the threat itself, allowing for scalable swarm defense where the cost of protection remains lower than the value of the infrastructure being protected."

nodes.title: Sidekick
nodes.description: An AI agent that manages frontline operations via text, handling work orders and machine monitoring without requiring a dedicated app. YC S26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://textsidekick.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/textsidekick

Sidekick is an AI agent designed to streamline frontline operations by interacting with workers through standard text messages. It allows employees to submit problems, photos, or voice memos in any language, after which the system answers queries using the company's internal documents, creates and routes work orders, and syncs with existing operational software. The tool requires no app installation or login, functioning on any phone to lower the barrier to entry for field teams.

The platform also monitors connected machine data to proactively alert workers when equipment performance begins to drift, aiming to prevent downtime before it occurs. Additionally, Sidekick builds a searchable knowledge base from every interaction, ensuring that institutional knowledge is retained and accessible rather than lost when experienced staff retire. The company is based in San Francisco and operates in the B2B and manufacturing sectors.

_Usage:_

"How does Sidekick handle the lack of a dedicated mobile app for field workers?"

"It bypasses the need for a specific app or login by operating entirely over standard SMS. Workers can send text messages, photos, or voice memos in any language, and the AI agent processes these inputs to answer questions from company documents, create work orders, and sync with existing software, making it accessible on any phone."

nodes.title: Sunflower
nodes.description: AI-native telemedicine clinic for addiction treatment. YC S26.
nodes.body:
**Website:** https://sunflowerclinic.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/sunflower

Sunflower is an AI-native telemedicine clinic focused on addiction care, addressing a significant gap in the market where over 18,750 patients are currently on waitlists for therapy or medication. The company is building clinical services to serve Medicaid, which spends over $30 billion annually on substance use disorder services, leveraging a substantial addressable market of $153 million in pending demand.

The company’s initial product, Sunflower Sober, was the first AI Sponsor for addiction, which reached 100 monthly active users in under six months and generates approximately $1.5 million in annual subscription revenue. Sunflower Sober is pacing to add over 800,000 new users per year, a growth rate the company notes is faster than that of Alcoholics Anonymous.

Based in San Francisco, the 15-person team includes clinical leaders from the Mayo Clinic, Choose Your Horizon, and Charlie Health. The company aims to combine its established brand in the sobriety community with robust clinical infrastructure to better serve patients.

_Usage:_

"How does Sunflower differentiate its AI approach from traditional addiction support groups like AA?"

"Sunflower operates as an AI-native telemedicine clinic rather than just a peer support group, combining its AI Sponsor app with actual clinical services. While it claims its user growth is faster than Alcoholics Anonymous, it distinguishes itself by providing direct medical and therapeutic care, specifically targeting the Medicaid market and serving patients who are currently on long waitlists for treatment."

Sunflower Sober is pacing to add over 800,000 new users per year, a growth rate the company notes is faster than that of Alcoholics Anonymous.

Based in San Francisco, the 15-person team includes clinical leaders from the Mayo Clinic, Choose Your Horizon, and Charlie Health. The company aims to combine its established brand in the sobriety community with robust clinical infrastructure to better serve patients.

nodes.body:
**Website:** http://www.astranis.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/astranis

Astranis designs, builds, and operates advanced satellites for high orbits, providing dedicated and secure telecommunications networks across the globe. The company caters to customers with stringent requirements for network visibility, uptime, customization, and data security, including large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

Operating out of a 153,000-square-foot headquarters in Northern California, Astranis handles the end-to-end design, manufacturing, and operation of its spacecraft.
